+-def binary_metrics(labels, probabilities, logits=None):
+-    y = np.asarray(labels, dtype=int)
+-    p = np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=float)
+-    if len(y) == 0 or len(y) != len(p) or not np.isfinite(p).all():
+-        raise ValueError("평가 라벨·예측 확률이 유효하지 않습니다.")
+-    if not set(y).issubset({0, 1}) or np.any((p < 0) | (p > 1)):
+-        raise ValueError("이진 라벨/확률 범위가 유효하지 않습니다.")
+-    score = p if logits is None else np.asarray(logits, dtype=np.float64)
+-    if len(score) != len(y) or not np.isfinite(score).all():
+-        raise ValueError("평가 로짓의 수 또는 유한성이 유효하지 않습니다.")
+-    predicted = (p >= 0.5).astype(int) if logits is None else (score >= 0).astype(int)
+-    consistent = bool(np.array_equal(predicted, (p >= 0.5).astype(int)))
+-    matrix = confusion_matrix(y, predicted, labels=[0, 1])
+-    tn, fp, fn, tp = matrix.ravel()
+-    return {"accuracy": float(accuracy_score(y, predicted)),
+-            "auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, score)) if len(set(y)) == 2 else None,
+-            "pr_auc": float(average_precision_score(y, score)) if len(set(y)) == 2 else None,
+-            "sensitivity": float(tp / (tp + fn)) if tp + fn else None,
+-            "specificity": float(tn / (tn + fp)) if tn + fp else None,
+-            "f1": float(f1_score(y, predicted, zero_division=0)),
+-            "confusion_matrix": matrix.tolist(), "threshold": 0.5, "n_images": len(y),
+-            "unit": "image", "patient_id_available": False, "threshold_consistent": consistent,
+-            "threshold_rounding_differences": int(np.count_nonzero(predicted != (p >= 0.5).astype(int))),
+-            "ranking_score": "raw_logits" if logits is not None else "probability",
+-            "ng_probability_mean": float(p.mean()), "brier_score": float(np.mean((p-y)**2)),
+-            "false_positive_rate": float(fp/(tn+fp)) if tn+fp else None}
+-
+-
+-def stable_binary_loss(logits, targets, dtype=torch.float32, reduction="mean"):
+-    # 확신한 음성의 input-logsigmoid 상쇄를 피하는 동일한 이진 교차 엔트로피입니다.
+-    signed = logits.to(dtype) * (targets.to(dtype) * 2 - 1)
+-    values = torch.nn.functional.softplus(-signed)
+-    if reduction == "sum":
+-        return values.sum()
+-    if reduction == "none":
+-        return values
+-    if reduction != "mean":
+-        raise ValueError("지원하지 않는 손실 집계 방식입니다.")
+-    return values.mean()
+-
+-
+-class TrainingControl:
+-    def __init__(self, min_delta=1e-4, patience=15, enabled=True):
+-        if min_delta < 0 or not math.isfinite(min_delta) or patience < 1 or type(enabled) is not bool:
+-            raise ValueError("조기 종료 정책이 유효하지 않습니다.")
+-        self.min_delta, self.patience = float(min_delta), int(patience)
+-        self.enabled = enabled
+-        self.best_raw_loss, self.best_raw_epoch = math.inf, 0
+-        self.meaningful_best_loss, self.stale_epochs = math.inf, 0
+-        self.optimizer_steps = 0
+-        self.shadow_stop_epoch, self.shadow_best_raw_epoch = 0, 0
+-
+-    def observe(self, loss, epoch):
+-        if not math.isfinite(loss) or loss < 0:
+-            raise ValueError("검증 손실은 유한한 0 이상이어야 합니다.")
+-        raw = loss < self.best_raw_loss
+-        meaningful = loss < self.meaningful_best_loss - self.min_delta
+-        if raw:
+-            self.best_raw_loss, self.best_raw_epoch = float(loss), int(epoch)
+-        if meaningful:
+-            self.meaningful_best_loss, self.stale_epochs = float(loss), 0
+-        else:
+-            self.stale_epochs += 1
+-        would_stop = self.stale_epochs >= self.patience
+-        if would_stop and not self.shadow_stop_epoch:
+-            self.shadow_stop_epoch, self.shadow_best_raw_epoch = int(epoch), self.best_raw_epoch
+-        return {"raw_improved": raw, "meaningful_improved": meaningful,
+-                "would_stop": would_stop, "should_stop": self.enabled and would_stop}
+-
+-    def state_dict(self):
+-        return {key: getattr(self, key) for key in ["min_delta", "patience", "best_raw_loss", "best_raw_epoch",
+-                                                    "meaningful_best_loss", "stale_epochs", "optimizer_steps",
+-                                                    "enabled", "shadow_stop_epoch", "shadow_best_raw_epoch"]}
+-
+-    def load_state_dict(self, values):
+-        if (values["min_delta"] != self.min_delta or values["patience"] != self.patience
+-                or values.get("enabled", True) is not self.enabled):
+-            raise ValueError("재개 조기 종료 정책이 현재 설정과 다릅니다.")
+-        for key in ["best_raw_loss", "best_raw_epoch", "meaningful_best_loss", "stale_epochs", "optimizer_steps"]:
+-            setattr(self, key, values[key])
+-        self.shadow_stop_epoch = values.get("shadow_stop_epoch", 0)
+-        self.shadow_best_raw_epoch = values.get("shadow_best_raw_epoch", 0)
+-
+-
+-def build_optimizer_scheduler(parameters, config):
+-    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(parameters, lr=config["learning_rate"], weight_decay=config["weight_decay"])
+-    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
+-        optimizer, mode="min", factor=config["scheduler_factor"], patience=config["scheduler_patience"],
+-        threshold=config["min_delta"], threshold_mode="abs", min_lr=config["min_learning_rate"])
+-    return optimizer, scheduler
+-
+-
+-def per_source_metrics(records, labels, probabilities, logits):
+-    result = {}
+-    for source in sorted({row["source_class"] for row in records}):
+-        indices = [index for index, row in enumerate(records) if row["source_class"] == source]
+-        result[source] = binary_metrics([labels[i] for i in indices], [probabilities[i] for i in indices],
+-                                        logits=[logits[i] for i in indices])
+-        result[source]["auc_note"] = "단일 라벨 원본 클래스는 AUC/AP를 계산하지 않습니다." if result[source]["auc"] is None else None
+-    return result
+-
+-
+-def seed_everything(seed, cpu_threads=4):
+-    random.seed(seed)
+-    np.random.seed(seed)
+-    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+-    torch.set_num_threads(cpu_threads)
+-    if torch.cuda.is_available():
+-        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
+-    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
+-    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
+-    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
+-
+-
+-def precision_policy(name, device_type, bf16_supported=None):
+-    if name not in {"fp32", "fp16", "bf16"}:
+-        raise ValueError(f"지원하지 않는 정밀도 설정입니다: {name}")
+-    if name != "fp32" and device_type != "cuda":
+-        raise ValueError("이 실험의 FP16/BF16은 CUDA 전용입니다. CPU 실행은 precision=fp32를 명시하세요.")
+-    if name == "bf16":
+-        supported = torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() if bf16_supported is None else bf16_supported
+-        if not supported:
+-            raise RuntimeError("요청한 BF16을 현재 CUDA 기기가 지원하지 않습니다. FP16으로 자동 대체하지 않았습니다.")
+-    return {"name": name, "dtype": {"fp32": torch.float32, "fp16": torch.float16, "bf16": torch.bfloat16}[name],
+-            "autocast_enabled": name != "fp32", "use_grad_scaler": name == "fp16"}
+-
+-
+-def restore_rng_state(checkpoint, device):
+-    # CUDA map_location으로 읽어도 생성기 상태는 CPU ByteTensor로 복구해야 합니다.
+-    torch.set_rng_state(checkpoint["torch_rng_state"].cpu())
+-    if device.type == "cuda":
+-        torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all([state.cpu() for state in checkpoint["cuda_rng_state"]])
+-
+-
+-def device_information(device):
+-    result = {"type": device.type, "name": "CPU", "torch_version": torch.__version__,
+-              "cuda_version": torch.version.cuda, "deterministic_algorithms": True}
+-    if device.type == "cuda":
+-        info = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device)
+-        free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
+-        result.update(name=info.name, total_memory_gb=round(total / 2 ** 30, 2),
+-                      free_memory_gb=round(free / 2 ** 30, 2), capability=list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)),
+-                      bf16_supported=torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported())
+-    return result
+-
+-
+-def _loader(dataset, config, device):
+-    return DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=config["batch_size"], shuffle=False,
+-                      num_workers=config.get("num_workers", 0), pin_memory=device.type == "cuda")
+-
+-
+-def evaluate(model, loader, device, precision, state=None, stage="validation"):
+-    model.eval()
+-    labels, probabilities, raw_logits = [], [], []
+-    total_loss = 0.0
+-    count = 0
+-    with torch.inference_mode():
+-        for batch_index, (images, target) in enumerate(loader, 1):
+-            images, target = images.to(device, non_blocking=True), target.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+-            # 평가는 학습 AMP와 분리하여 FP32 정방향과 FP64 손실/확률 계산을 사용합니다.
+-            with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=False):
+-                logits = model(images.float())
+-            logits64 = logits.double()
+-            loss = stable_binary_loss(logits64, target, dtype=torch.float64, reduction="sum")
+-            if not torch.isfinite(loss):
+-                raise FloatingPointError("평가 손실에 NaN/Inf가 발생했습니다.")
+-            total_loss += loss.item()
+-            count += len(target)
+-            labels.extend(target.cpu().int().tolist())
+-            probabilities.extend(logits64.sigmoid().cpu().tolist())
+-            raw_logits.extend(logits64.cpu().tolist())
+-            if state and (batch_index == 1 or batch_index % 10 == 0 or batch_index == len(loader)):
+-                state.update(stage=stage, batch=batch_index, batches=len(loader),
+-                             message=f"{'시험' if stage == 'testing' else '검증'} 원본 영상 {count}개 평가 중")
+-    metrics = binary_metrics(labels, probabilities, logits=raw_logits)
+-    metrics["loss"] = total_loss / count
+-    metrics.update(forward_precision="fp32", loss_precision="fp64_signed_softplus",
+-                   logit_min=min(raw_logits), logit_max=max(raw_logits))
+-    records = getattr(loader.dataset, "records", None)
+-    if records is not None:
+-        if len(records) != count:
+-            raise ValueError("원본 클래스별 평가 목록과 예측 수가 다릅니다.")
+-        metrics["per_source"] = per_source_metrics(records, labels, probabilities, raw_logits)
+-    return metrics, labels, probabilities
+-
+-
+-def _save_predictions(path, rows, labels, probabilities):
+-    with Path(path).open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
+-        writer = csv.writer(stream)
+-        writer.writerow(["relative_path", "label", "ng_probability"])
+-        for row, label, probability in zip(rows, labels, probabilities):
+-            writer.writerow([row["relative_path"], label, probability])
+-
+-
+-def _save_checkpoint(path, payload):
+-    path = Path(path)
+-    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
+-    torch.save(payload, temporary)
+-    os.replace(temporary, path)
+-
+-
+-def _freeze_prefix_checkpoint(source, destination):
+-    """기존 최저 검증 손실 파일을 RNG 사용 없이 한 번 고정하고 복사 해시를 확인합니다."""
+-    source, destination = Path(source), Path(destination)
+-    digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+-    if destination.exists():
+-        if hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
+-            raise ValueError("이미 고정된 관찰용 체크포인트를 교체할 수 없습니다.")
+-        return digest
+-    temporary = destination.with_suffix(".tmp")
+-    try:
+-        shutil.copyfile(source, temporary)
+-        if hashlib.sha256(temporary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
+-            raise ValueError("관찰용 체크포인트 복사 해시가 다릅니다.")
+-        os.replace(temporary, destination)
+-    finally:
+-        if temporary.exists():
+-            temporary.unlink()
+-    return digest
+-
+-
+-def _check_prefix_hash(path, expected):
+-    if (not isinstance(expected, str) or len(expected) != 64
+-            or hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected):
+-        raise ValueError("고정된 관찰용 체크포인트 해시가 재개 기록과 다릅니다.")
+-
+-
+-def _run_identity(root, config, manifest_sha256):
+-    root = Path(root)
+-    sources = [root / "run_training.py", root / "config.json", *sorted((root / "src").glob("*.py"))]
+-    source_hashes = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources}
+-    settings = {"config": config, "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha256, "source_hashes": source_hashes}
+-    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(settings, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
+-    return digest, settings
+-
+-
+-def run_training(config, root, state, device_name="cuda"):
+-    root = Path(root)
+-    started = time.monotonic()
+-    seed_everything(config["seed"], config.get("cpu_threads", 4))
+-    if device_name == "cuda" and not torch.cuda.is_available():
+-        raise RuntimeError("CUDA GPU를 요청했지만 사용할 수 없습니다. CPU로 자동 대체하지 않았습니다.")
+-    device = torch.device("cuda" if device_name == "auto" and torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu" if device_name == "auto" else device_name)
+-    precision = precision_policy(config["precision"], device.type)
+-    precision_info = {key: value for key, value in precision.items() if key != "dtype"}
+-    policy = {"max_epochs": config["epochs"], "patience": config["early_stopping_patience"],
+-              "early_stopping_enabled": config.get("early_stopping_enabled", True),
+-              "min_delta": config["min_delta"], "min_delta_mode": "absolute", "batch_size": config["batch_size"],
+-              "optimizer": "AdamW", "initial_learning_rate": config["learning_rate"], "weight_decay": config["weight_decay"],
+-              "scheduler_patience": config["scheduler_patience"], "scheduler_factor": config["scheduler_factor"],
+-              "min_learning_rate": config["min_learning_rate"], "evaluation_forward": "fp32", "evaluation_loss": "fp64_signed_softplus"}
+-    state.update(device=device_information(device), precision=precision_info, training_policy=policy,
+-                 learning_rate=config["learning_rate"], optimizer_steps=0, best_epoch=0, best_raw_epoch=0,
+-                 early_stopping_wait=0, stage="preparing", message="원본 해시와 유사 그룹 분할을 확인하는 중")
+-    manifest = prepare_dataset(config, root)
+-    run_id, settings = _run_identity(root, config, manifest["manifest_sha256"])
+-    result_dir = root / "work/results" / f"run_{run_id}"
+-    checkpoint_dir = root / "work/checkpoints" / f"run_{run_id}"
+-    result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-    checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-    atomic_json(result_dir / "run_metadata.json", {**settings, "run_id": run_id, "started_at": now_kst(),
+-                                                  "device": state.data["device"], "training_policy": policy,
+-                                                  "protocol": "similarity-group preliminary holdout"})
+-    state.update(dataset=manifest["summary"], run_id=run_id, result_directory=result_dir.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+-    state.event("자료 검증 완료", {"run_id": run_id, "summary": manifest["summary"]})
+-    splits = manifest["splits"]
+-    training = CTDataset(splits["train"], config["image_size"], training=True,
+-                         samples_per_class=config["samples_per_class"], seed=config["seed"])
+-    validation = CTDataset(splits["validation"], config["image_size"], training=False)
+-    test = CTDataset(splits["test"], config["image_size"], training=False)
+-    train_loader, val_loader, test_loader = [_loader(dataset, config, device) for dataset in [training, validation, test]]
+-    completed_steps = 0
+-    for sigma_index, sigma in enumerate(config["sigmas"], 1):
+-        entry = state.data["sigma_queue"][sigma_index - 1]
+-        metrics_file = result_dir / f"sigma_{sigma}_metrics.json"
+-        if metrics_file.exists():
+-            # 완료된 결과는 동일한 소스·설정·자료 해시에 한해서만 재사용합니다.
+-            result = json.loads(metrics_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+-            entry.update(status="completed", result=metrics_file.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+-            history_file = result_dir / f"sigma_{sigma}_history.json"
+-            if history_file.exists():
+-                state.data["history"].extend(json.loads(history_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
+-            completed_steps += result["optimizer_steps"]
+-            state.update(evaluation=result, run_optimizer_steps=completed_steps)
+-            state.event("완료 조건 재사용", {"sigma": sigma, "run_id": run_id})
+-            continue
+-        entry["status"] = "running"
+-        seed_everything(config["seed"], config.get("cpu_threads", 4))
+-        state.update(stage="loading_model", status="running", sigma=sigma, sigma_index=sigma_index,
+-                     epoch=0, batch=0, batches=len(train_loader), seen_per_class={"OK": 0, "NG": 0},
+-                     best_epoch=0, best_raw_epoch=0, best_raw_loss=None, meaningful_best_loss=None,
+-                     early_stopping_wait=0, optimizer_steps=0, learning_rate=config["learning_rate"],
+-                     train_loss=None, attempted_batch=0,
+-                     evaluation=None, message=f"σ={sigma}: 동일 ImageNet 초기값 모델 구성 중")
+-        model = SplitResNet50(sigma=sigma, pretrained=True).to(device)
+-        optimizer, scheduler = build_optimizer_scheduler([p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad], config)
+-        scaler = torch.amp.GradScaler("cuda", enabled=precision["use_grad_scaler"])
+-        control = TrainingControl(config["min_delta"], config["early_stopping_patience"],
+-                                  enabled=policy["early_stopping_enabled"])
+-        checkpoint = checkpoint_dir / f"sigma_{sigma}_best.pt"
+-        latest_checkpoint = checkpoint_dir / f"sigma_{sigma}_last.pt"
+-        prefix_checkpoint = checkpoint_dir / f"sigma_{sigma}_shadow_prefix_best.pt"
+-        prefix_sha256 = None
+-        sigma_history = []
+-        start_epoch = 1
+-        stopping_reason = "max_epochs"
+-        if latest_checkpoint.exists():
+-            saved = torch.load(latest_checkpoint, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
+-            if saved["run_id"] != run_id or saved["sigma"] != sigma:
+-                raise ValueError("재개 체크포인트의 자료·설정 식별자가 일치하지 않습니다.")
+-            model.load_state_dict(saved["model"])
+-            optimizer.load_state_dict(saved["optimizer"])
+-            scheduler.load_state_dict(saved["scheduler"])
+-            scaler.load_state_dict(saved["scaler"])
+-            control.load_state_dict(saved["training_control"])
+-            prefix_sha256 = saved.get("shadow_prefix_sha256")
+-            if not control.enabled and control.shadow_stop_epoch:
+-                _check_prefix_hash(prefix_checkpoint, prefix_sha256)
+-            sigma_history = saved["history"]
+-            start_epoch = saved["epoch"] + 1
+-            restore_rng_state(saved, device)
+-            state.data["history"].extend(sigma_history)
+-            state.event("체크포인트 재개", {"sigma": sigma, "epoch": start_epoch, "run_id": run_id,
+-                                              "optimizer_steps": control.optimizer_steps,
+-                                              "learning_rate": optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"],
+-                                              "meaningful_best_loss": control.meaningful_best_loss})
+-        state.update(learning_rate=optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"], optimizer_steps=control.optimizer_steps,
+-                     early_stopping_wait=control.stale_epochs, best_epoch=control.best_raw_epoch,
+-                     best_raw_epoch=control.best_raw_epoch, run_optimizer_steps=completed_steps + control.optimizer_steps)
+-        state.event("학습 조건 시작", {"sigma": sigma, "epochs": config["epochs"], "batches": len(train_loader),
+-                                        "samples_per_class": config["samples_per_class"], "image_size": config["image_size"]})
+-        for epoch in range(start_epoch, config["epochs"] + 1):
+-            if control.enabled and control.stale_epochs >= control.patience:
+-                stopping_reason = "meaningful_validation_plateau"
+-                break
+-            training.set_epoch(epoch - 1)
+-            model.train()
+-            total_loss = 0.0
+-            seen = {"OK": 0, "NG": 0}
+-            epoch_started = time.monotonic()
+-            state.update(stage="training", epoch=epoch, batch=0, batches=len(train_loader), seen_per_class=seen.copy(),
+-                         message=f"σ={sigma}: {epoch}/{config['epochs']} epoch 학습 중")
+-            for batch_index, (images, target) in enumerate(train_loader, 1):
+-                state.data["attempted_batch"] = batch_index
+-                images, target = images.to(device, non_blocking=True), target.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+-                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+-                with torch.autocast(device_type=device.type, dtype=precision["dtype"], enabled=precision["autocast_enabled"]):
+-                    logits = model(images)
+-                    loss = stable_binary_loss(logits, target, dtype=torch.float32)
+-                if not torch.isfinite(loss):
+-                    raise FloatingPointError(f"σ={sigma}, epoch={epoch}, batch={batch_index}: 학습 손실 NaN/Inf")
+-                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
+-                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
+-                gradient_norm = nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0, error_if_nonfinite=True)
+-                scaler.step(optimizer)
+-                scaler.update()
+-                control.optimizer_steps += 1
+-                total_loss += loss.item() * len(target)
+-                ng = int(target.sum().item())
+-                seen["NG"] += ng
+-                seen["OK"] += len(target) - ng
+-                if batch_index == 1 or batch_index % config["status_every_batches"] == 0 or batch_index == len(train_loader):
+-                    state.update(stage="training", batch=batch_index, batches=len(train_loader), seen_per_class=seen.copy(),
+-                                 train_loss=total_loss / sum(seen.values()), elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
+-                                 last_gradient_norm=gradient_norm.item(),
+-                                 learning_rate=optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"], optimizer_steps=control.optimizer_steps,
+-                                 run_optimizer_steps=completed_steps + control.optimizer_steps,
+-                                 epoch_elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic() - epoch_started, 1),
+-                                 message=f"σ={sigma}: epoch {epoch}, 실제 학습 {sum(seen.values())}/{len(training)} 표본")
+-                if batch_index == 1:
+-                    state.event("실제 학습 배치 완료", {"sigma": sigma, "epoch": epoch, "batch": 1,
+-                                                         "loss": loss.item(), "device": device.type})
+-            if seen != {"OK": config["samples_per_class"], "NG": config["samples_per_class"]}:
+-                raise AssertionError(f"클래스별 실제 학습 표본 수가 다릅니다: {seen}")

+-        connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.server.server_port, timeout=3)
+-        headers = {"Host": host or f"127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}"}
+-        if authenticated:
+-            headers["Cookie"] = "dashboard_session=test-session-token"
+-        connection.request("GET", path, headers=headers)
+-        response = connection.getresponse()
+-        result = response.status, dict(response.getheaders()), response.read()
+-        connection.close()

+-"""자료 누수·균형 표본·모델 절단·블러의 실제 동작을 검사합니다."""

+-def load_module(name):
+-    try:
+-        return importlib.import_module(name)
+-    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
+-        if exc.name in {"src", name}:
+-            raise AssertionError(f"아직 구현되지 않은 학습 모듈: {name}") from exc
+-        raise
+-

+-def legacy_read_lock(path):
+-    """제품에서 쓰지 않는 삭제 공유 없는 Windows 핸들을 검사 목적으로 엽니다."""
+-    import ctypes
+-    from ctypes import wintypes
+-    kernel = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
+-    create_file = kernel.CreateFileW
+-    create_file.argtypes = [wintypes.LPCWSTR, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD, ctypes.c_void_p,
+-                            wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.HANDLE]
+-    create_file.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
+-    close_handle = kernel.CloseHandle
+-    close_handle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
+-    close_handle.restype = wintypes.BOOL
+-    handle = create_file(str(path), 0x80000000, 3, None, 3, 128, None)
+-    if handle == ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value:
+-        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
+-    return lambda: close_handle(handle)

+-    def test_dct_blur_matches_independent_scipy_reference(self):
+-        import numpy as np
+-        import torch
+-        from scipy.fft import dctn, idctn
+-        blur = load_module("src.model").GaussianDCTBlur(2)
+-        rng = np.random.default_rng(9)
+-        original = rng.normal(size=(2, 3, 12, 16)).astype(np.float32)
+-        yy = np.pi * np.arange(12) / 12
+-        xx = np.pi * np.arange(16) / 16
+-        attenuation = np.exp(-2 * (yy[:, None] ** 2 + xx[None, :] ** 2))
+-        expected = idctn(dctn(original, type=2, norm="ortho", axes=(-2, -1)) * attenuation, type=2, norm="ortho", axes=(-2, -1))
+-        actual = blur(torch.from_numpy(original)).numpy()
+-        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5)

+-    def test_blur_identity_mean_and_sigma_strength(self):
+-        import torch
+-        GaussianDCTBlur = load_module("src.model").GaussianDCTBlur
+-        original = torch.arange(2 * 3 * 16 * 16).reshape(2, 3, 16, 16).float() / 100
+-        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(GaussianDCTBlur(0)(original), original))
+-        weak = GaussianDCTBlur(1)(original)
+-        strong = GaussianDCTBlur(8)(original)
+-        torch.testing.assert_close(weak.mean((-2, -1)), original.mean((-2, -1)), atol=2e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+-        self.assertLess(strong.var((-2, -1)).mean().item(), weak.var((-2, -1)).mean().item())
+-        for sigma in [-1, float("nan"), float("inf")]:
+-            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+-                GaussianDCTBlur(sigma)

+-    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "nt", "Windows 공유 삭제 제한 동시 읽기·쓰기 검사")
+-    def test_atomic_status_windows_reader_writer_500_updates(self):
+-        import threading
+-        import time
+-        import dashboard
+-        state_module = load_module("src.state")
+-        ready, stop = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
+-        failures, read_sequences, lock_conflicts = [], [], []
+-        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+-            destination = Path(directory) / "status.json"
+-            state_module.atomic_json(destination, {"sequence": 0, "data": "x" * 2048})
+-
+-            def read_while_writing():
+-                first = True
+-                while not stop.is_set():
+-                    try:
+-                        # 실제 제품의 삭제 공유 reader로 500회 원자교체와 공존하는지 검사합니다.
+-                        with dashboard.open_status_file(destination) as stream:
+-                            payload = json.loads(stream.read().decode("utf-8"))
+-                            if len(payload["data"]) != 2048 or not isinstance(payload["sequence"], int):
+-                                failures.append("부분 상태 또는 잘못된 내용")
+-                            read_sequences.append(payload["sequence"])
+-                            ready.set()
+-                            time.sleep(0.03 if first else 0.0002)
+-                            first = False
+-                    except Exception as error:
+-                        failures.append(repr(error))
+-                        ready.set()
+-                        return
+-                    stop.wait(0.0005)
+-
+-            reader = threading.Thread(target=read_while_writing, daemon=True)
+-            real_replace = state_module.replace_file
+-
+-            def observed_replace(source, target):
+-                try:
+-                    return real_replace(source, target)
+-                except PermissionError as error:
+-                    lock_conflicts.append(getattr(error, "winerror", None))
+-                    raise
+-
+-            reader.start()
+-            self.assertTrue(ready.wait(3), "동시 읽기 작업이 시작되지 않았습니다.")
+-            try:
+-                with mock.patch.object(state_module, "replace_file", side_effect=observed_replace):
+-                    for sequence in range(1, 501):
+-                        state_module.atomic_json(destination, {"sequence": sequence, "data": "x" * 2048})
+-            finally:
+-                stop.set()
+-                reader.join(timeout=3)
+-            self.assertFalse(reader.is_alive())
+-            self.assertFalse(failures, failures)
+-            self.assertGreater(len(read_sequences), 0)
+-            self.assertEqual(lock_conflicts, [], "제품 reader는 원자교체를 잠그지 않아야 합니다.")
+-            self.assertEqual(json.loads(destination.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sequence"], 500)
+-            self.assertFalse(list(Path(directory).glob("*.tmp")))

+-def file_digest(path):
+-    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+-    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
+-        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+-            digest.update(block)
+-    return digest.hexdigest()
+-
+-
+-def records_digest(rows):
+-    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+-
+-
+-def json_bytes(payload):
+-    return (json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+-
+-
+-def safe_path(root, relative):
+-    root = Path(root).resolve()
+-    value = PurePosixPath(str(relative).replace("\\", "/"))
+-    if value.is_absolute() or any(part in {"..", "."} or ":" in part for part in value.parts):
+-        raise ValueError("허용한 폴더 밖의 경로입니다.")
+-    path = root.joinpath(*value.parts)
+-    if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
+-        raise ValueError("폴더 경계를 벗어나는 파일입니다.")
+-    for item in [path, *path.parents]:
+-        if item == root:
+-            break
+-        if item.is_symlink() or (hasattr(item, "is_junction") and item.is_junction()):
+-            raise ValueError("복구 파일에서 폴더 연결을 따라가지 않습니다.")
+-    return path
+-
+-
+-def read_baseline(path, expected_sha256):
+-    if file_digest(path) != expected_sha256:
+-        raise ValueError("복구 기준 파일의 외부 고정 SHA와 다릅니다.")
+-    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+-
+-
+-def verify_files(root, files):
+-    for relative, expected in files.items():
+-        if file_digest(safe_path(root, relative)) != expected:
+-            raise ValueError(f"원본 SHA가 다릅니다: {relative}")
+-

+-def relocate_manifest(source, old_prefix, new_prefix):
+-    if source.get("manifest_sha256") != records_digest(source.get("records")):
+-        raise ValueError("원본 목록의 파생 SHA가 다릅니다.")
+-    target = copy.deepcopy(source)
+-    old_prefix, new_prefix = old_prefix.replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/"), new_prefix.replace("\\", "/").rstrip("/")
+-    for rows in [target["records"], *target["splits"].values()]:
+-        for row in rows:
+-            relative = row["relative_path"]
+-            pieces = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
+-            if PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in {"..", "."} or ":" in p or "\\" in p for p in pieces):
+-                raise ValueError("원본 목록의 상대 경로가 유효하지 않습니다.")
+-            expected = old_prefix + "/" + relative
+-            if row["path"].replace("\\", "/") != expected:
+-                raise ValueError("명시한 원본 접두와 상대 경로가 일치하지 않습니다.")
+-            # 원본 경로의 구분자 표기도 보존하고 드라이브 접두만 바꿉니다.
+-            separator = "\\" if "\\" in row["path"] else "/"
+-            row["path"] = (new_prefix + "/" + relative).replace("/", separator)
+-    target["manifest_sha256"] = records_digest(target["records"])
+-    return target

+-def relocated_config(source, new_dataset, target_manifest):

+-                  expected_reference_manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json_bytes(target_manifest)).hexdigest(),
+-                  expected_reference_records_sha256=target_manifest["manifest_sha256"])
+-    return result

+-def assert_state_equal(before, after):
+-    if isinstance(before, torch.Tensor):
+-        if not isinstance(after, torch.Tensor) or before.dtype != after.dtype or before.shape != after.shape or not torch.equal(before.cpu(), after.cpu()):
+-            raise ValueError("복구 변환에서 tensor 값·형식이 변경됐습니다.")
+-    elif type(before) is not type(after):
+-        raise ValueError("복구 변환에서 상태의 자료형이 변경됐습니다.")
+-    elif isinstance(before, dict):
+-        if before.keys() != after.keys():
+-            raise ValueError("복구 변환에서 상태 키가 변경됐습니다.")
+-        for key in before:
+-            assert_state_equal(before[key], after[key])
+-    elif isinstance(before, (list, tuple)):
+-        if len(before) != len(after):
+-            raise ValueError("복구 변환에서 상태 길이가 변경됐습니다.")
+-        for left, right in zip(before, after):
+-            assert_state_equal(left, right)
+-    elif before != after:
+-        raise ValueError("허용한 식별자 이외의 상태가 변경됐습니다.")

+-def rebind_checkpoint(source, old_run_id, new_run_id, sigma, prefix_sha256=None):
+-    if source.get("run_id") != old_run_id or source.get("sigma") != sigma:
+-        raise ValueError("가져올 체크포인트 실행·강도가 다릅니다.")
+-    # tensor는 수정하지 않고 새 mapping만 만듭니다. 저장 후 재로딩으로 내용도 대조합니다.
+-    target = dict(source, run_id=new_run_id)
+-    if source.get("shadow_prefix_sha256") is not None:
+-        if not prefix_sha256:
+-            raise ValueError("변환한 prefix SHA가 필요합니다.")
+-        target["shadow_prefix_sha256"] = prefix_sha256
+-    return target
+-
+-
+-def convert_checkpoint(source_path, target_path, old_run_id, new_run_id, sigma, prefix_sha256=None):
+-    source = torch.load(source_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+-    target = rebind_checkpoint(source, old_run_id, new_run_id, sigma, prefix_sha256)
+-    Path(target_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-    torch.save(target, target_path)
+-    restored = torch.load(target_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+-    assert_state_equal(target, restored)
+-    result = {"source_sha256": file_digest(source_path), "new_sha256": file_digest(target_path),
+-              "epoch": source["epoch"], "tensor_and_state_equal": True}
+-    del source, target, restored
+-    gc.collect()
+-    return result

+-                or abs(value["accuracy"] - (matrix[0][0] + matrix[1][1]) / count) > 1e-12):

+-def rebind_metric(source, old_run_id, new_run_id, sigma, prefix_sha256):

+-        raise ValueError("완료 결과의 실행·강도가 다릅니다.")

+-        validate_metric(comparison)

+-def build_target_config(source_root, target_root, baseline):

+-    if file_digest(reference) != baseline["reference_file_sha256"]:
+-        raise ValueError("보존한 원본 기준 목록 SHA가 다릅니다.")
+-    source = json.loads(reference.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+-        raise ValueError("보존한 원본 목록 SHA가 다릅니다.")
+-    actual = json.loads((Path(source_root) / "work/results/dataset_manifest_private.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+-    if source["records"] != actual["records"] or source["splits"] != actual["splits"]:
+-        raise ValueError("원본 실행과 기준 목록의 원본·정확한 분할이 다릅니다.")
+-    target = relocate_manifest(source, baseline["source_dataset_prefix"], baseline["target_dataset_prefix"])
+-    config = relocated_config(baseline["source_config"], baseline["target_dataset_prefix"], target)
+-    return config, target

+-def verify_import(root, initial=True, expected_baseline_sha256=None):
+-    root = Path(root)

+-    if expected_baseline_sha256 is not None and lineage["baseline_sha256"] != expected_baseline_sha256:
+-        raise ValueError("복구 계보의 기준 SHA가 명시한 외부 승인값과 다릅니다.")
+-    baseline = read_baseline(lineage["baseline_path"], lineage["baseline_sha256"])
+-    for name in SCIENTIFIC:
+-        if file_digest(root / name) != baseline["source_files"][name]:
+-            raise ValueError("복구 후 학습 소스가 변경됐습니다.")
+-    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+-    manifest = json.loads((root / REFERENCE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+-    assert_config_compatible(baseline["source_config"], config, baseline["target_dataset_prefix"], manifest)
+-    validate_reference_manifest(config, root, manifest)
+-    run_id, settings = _run_identity(root, config, manifest["manifest_sha256"])
+-    if run_id != lineage["run_id"] or settings != lineage["settings"]:
+-        raise ValueError("복구 실행 식별자·설정이 계보와 다릅니다.")
+-    if initial:
+-        verify_files(root, lineage["imported_files"])
+-    for sigma_text, spec in lineage["transfer"].items():
+-        folder = root / f"work/checkpoints/run_{run_id}"

+-def main():
+-    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="보존한 체크포인트의 명시적 경로 복구")
+-    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("configure", "import", "verify"))
+-    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, default=ROOT.parent / "4차")
+-    parser.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path, default=ROOT / "work/recovery/원본_복구기준_비공개.json")
+-    parser.add_argument("--baseline-sha256", required=True)
+-    args = parser.parse_args()
+-    if args.command == "verify":
+-        # verify도 외부 기준을 다시 확인합니다.
+-        read_baseline(args.baseline, args.baseline_sha256)
+-        result = verify_import(ROOT, expected_baseline_sha256=args.baseline_sha256)
+-    elif args.command == "configure":
+-        baseline = read_baseline(args.baseline, args.baseline_sha256)
+-        verify_files(args.source_root, baseline["source_files"])
+-        config, _manifest = build_target_config(args.source_root, ROOT, baseline)

+-    else:

+-        result = {key: result[key] for key in ("source_run_id", "run_id", "original_images_byte_verified", "transfer")}
+-    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+-    return 0

+-    raise SystemExit(main())

+-def exception_payload(error):
+-    return {"time_kst": datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=9))).isoformat(),
+-            "error_type": type(error).__name__, "error": str(error),
+-            "errno": getattr(error, "errno", None), "winerror": getattr(error, "winerror", None),

+-def write_independent_logs(folders, filename, payload):
+-    """한 볼륨의 오류가 다른 볼륨의 원오류 기록을 막지 않게 각각 저장합니다."""
+-    failures, good = [], []
+-    for folder in map(Path, folders):
+-        try:
+-            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-            path = folder / filename
+-            with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+-                json.dump({**payload, "secondary_log_errors": failures}, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+-                stream.write("\n"); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+-            good.append(path)
+-        except Exception as error:
+-            failures.append({"folder": str(folder), **exception_payload(error)})
+-    # 성공한 볼륨에도 먼저/나중에 생긴 secondary 오류를 함께 남깁니다.
+-    if failures:
+-        for path in good:
+-            try:
+-                with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+-                    json.dump({**payload, "secondary_log_errors": failures}, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+-                    stream.write("\n"); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+-            except Exception as error:
+-                print(json.dumps({"secondary_log_error": exception_payload(error)}, ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+-    return failures

+-def require_free_space(path, minimum):

+-        raise OSError(28, f"저장 여유 공간이 기준보다 작습니다: free={free}, required={minimum}, volume={probe.anchor}")

+-def windows_process(pid):
+-    """숫자로 확인한 단일 PID의 부모와 실행파일만 읽습니다."""
+-    if type(pid) is not int or pid <= 0:
+-        raise ValueError("유효한 프로세스 PID가 필요합니다.")
+-    command = ("$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); "
+-               f"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId = {pid}' | "
+-               "Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
+-    result = subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", command],
+-                            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="strict", timeout=20,
+-                            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0))
+-    if result.returncode:
+-        raise RuntimeError("worker 감독 연결 조회 실패: " + result.stderr)
+-    return json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout.strip() else None

+-def worker_parent_authorized(supervisor_pid):
+-    """직접 감독 또는 그 감독이 만든 동일 venv launcher 한 단계만 허용합니다."""
+-    if (not isinstance(supervisor_pid, str) or not supervisor_pid.isascii()
+-            or not supervisor_pid.isdecimal() or int(supervisor_pid) <= 0):
+-        return False
+-    supervisor_pid = int(supervisor_pid)
+-    parent_pid = os.getppid()
+-    if parent_pid == supervisor_pid:
+-        return True
+-    if os.name != "nt":
+-        return False
+-    launcher = windows_process(parent_pid)
+-    if (not isinstance(launcher, dict) or launcher.get("ProcessId") != parent_pid
+-            or launcher.get("ParentProcessId") != supervisor_pid
+-            or not isinstance(launcher.get("ExecutablePath"), str)):
+-        return False
+-    normalize = lambda path: os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path))
+-    return normalize(launcher["ExecutablePath"]) == normalize(sys.executable)

+-def windows_arguments(command_line):
+-    """Windows의 실제 따옴표 규칙으로 명령행을 분리하며 작업 폴더는 추측하지 않습니다."""
+-    from ctypes import wintypes
+-    count = ctypes.c_int()
+-    parse = ctypes.WinDLL("shell32", use_last_error=True).CommandLineToArgvW
+-    parse.argtypes = [wintypes.LPCWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
+-    parse.restype = ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.LPWSTR)
+-    arguments = parse(command_line, ctypes.byref(count))
+-    if not arguments:
+-        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
+-    release = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True).LocalFree
+-    release.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
+-    release.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
+-    try:
+-        return [arguments[index] for index in range(count.value)]
+-    finally:
+-        release(ctypes.cast(arguments, ctypes.c_void_p))

+-                          for index, value in enumerate(arguments))
+-        ambiguous = module_call or any(not ntpath.isabs(script) for script in scripts)
+-        same_project = any(ntpath.splitdrive(script)[1].replace("\\", "/").lower().startswith(suffix.rstrip("/") + "/")
+-                           for script in scripts if ntpath.isabs(script))
+-        if ambiguous or same_project:
+-            found.append({"pid": row["ProcessId"], "command": command_line,
+-                          "reason": "상대 호출의 작업 폴더를 확인할 수 없습니다." if ambiguous else "같은 프로젝트의 학습입니다."})
+-    return found
+-
+-
+-def log_folders(root):
+-    local = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", str(Path.home() / "AppData/Local")))
+-    return [Path(root) / "work/recovery_logs", local / "폐CT_학습복구" / "5차"]
+-
+-
+-def worker(root, device, folders):
+-    """기존 run_training.py의 오류 처리 전에 원오류를 먼저 잡는 별도 진입점입니다."""
+-    os.environ.setdefault("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG", ":4096:8")
+-    os.environ.setdefault("TORCH_HOME", str(Path(root) / "work/torch-cache"))
+-    from src.state import StatusWriter, atomic_json
+-    from src.training import run_training
+-    state = None
+-    try:
+-        config = json.loads((Path(root) / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+-        state = StatusWriter(root, config)
+-        state.update()
+-        run_training(config, root, state, device)
+-        return 0
+-    except BaseException as error:
+-        # 원오류를 상태 갱신·추가 오류 기록보다 먼저 고정합니다.
+-        details = exception_payload(error)
+-        details.update(sigma=state.data.get("sigma") if state else None,
+-                       epoch=state.data.get("epoch") if state else None,
+-                       attempted_batch=state.data.get("attempted_batch") if state else None)
+-        name = "원오류_" + datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f") + ".json"
+-        failures = write_independent_logs(folders, name, details)
+-        secondary = []
+-        try:
+-            atomic_json(Path(root) / "work/runtime/last_error.json", details)
+-        except Exception as followup:
+-            secondary.append(exception_payload(followup))
+-        if state:
+-            try:
+-                interrupted = isinstance(error, KeyboardInterrupt)
+-                for entry in state.data["sigma_queue"]:
+-                    if entry["status"] == "running":
+-                        entry["status"] = "failed"
+-                state.update(stage="interrupted" if interrupted else "error", status="interrupted" if interrupted else "failed",
+-                             pid=None, error=details, message=f"학습 중단: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
+-                state.event("복구 실행 중단", details)
+-            except Exception as followup:
+-                secondary.append(exception_payload(followup))
+-        if failures or secondary:
+-            write_independent_logs(folders, name, {**details, "secondary_status_errors": secondary,
+-                                                   "initial_log_errors": failures})
+-        print(details["traceback"], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+-        return 130 if isinstance(error, KeyboardInterrupt) else 1
+-
+-
+-def supervise(root, device, baseline_sha256):
+-    root = Path(root).resolve()
+-    folders = log_folders(root)
+-    stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
+-    lock = root / "work/runtime/recovery.lock"
+-    child = None
+-    locked = False
+-    try:
+-        storage = {"training_free": require_free_space(root, MIN_TRAIN_FREE),
+-                   "independent_log_free": require_free_space(folders[1], MIN_LOG_FREE)}
+-        if root.anchor.lower() == folders[1].anchor.lower():
+-            raise ValueError("독립 오류 로그는 학습과 다른 볼륨이어야 합니다.")
+-        reject_duplicates(training_processes(root.parent))
+-        from tools.recovery import verify_import
+-        recovery = verify_import(root, initial=False, expected_baseline_sha256=baseline_sha256)
+-        lock.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-        descriptor = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
+-        locked = True
+-        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+-            json.dump({"pid": os.getpid(), "time": stamp, **storage, **recovery}, stream, ensure_ascii=False)
+-        argv = [sys.executable, "-B", "-X", "utf8", "-u", str(root / "복구_학습.py"), "--worker", "--device", device]
+-        errors = write_independent_logs(folders, f"실행_{stamp}.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), **storage, **recovery})
+-        if errors:
+-            raise OSError("학습 시작 전 두 볼륨의 독립 로그를 모두 만들지 못했습니다.")
+-        environment = dict(os.environ, CT_RECOVERY_SUPERVISOR_PID=str(os.getpid()))
+-        child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=environment)
+-        log_errors = []
+-
+-        def pump(pipe, kind):
+-            streams = []
+-            for folder in folders:
+-                try:
+-                    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+-                    streams.append((folder, (folder / f"학습_{stamp}.{kind}.log").open("xb")))
+-                except Exception as error:
+-                    log_errors.append(exception_payload(error))
+-            try:
+-                for block in iter(lambda: pipe.read1(4096), b""):
+-                    for folder, stream in list(streams):
+-                        try:
+-                            stream.write(block); stream.flush()
+-                        except Exception as error:
+-                            log_errors.append({"folder": str(folder), **exception_payload(error)})
+-                            streams.remove((folder, stream)); stream.close()
+-                    target = sys.stderr if kind == "stderr" else sys.stdout
+-                    try:
+-                        target.buffer.write(block); target.buffer.flush()
+-                    except (OSError, AttributeError):
+-                        pass
+-            finally:
+-                pipe.close()
+-                for _folder, stream in streams:
+-                    stream.close()
+-
+-        pumps = [threading.Thread(target=pump, args=(child.stdout, "stdout")),
+-                 threading.Thread(target=pump, args=(child.stderr, "stderr"))]
+-        for thread in pumps:
+-            thread.start()
+-        code = child.wait()
+-        for thread in pumps:
+-            thread.join()
+-        write_independent_logs(folders, f"종료_{stamp}.json", {"exit_code": code, "child_pid": child.pid,
+-                                                           "time_kst": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), "secondary_stream_errors": log_errors})
+-        return code
+-    except BaseException as error:
+-        details = exception_payload(error)
+-        write_independent_logs(folders, f"실행경계오류_{stamp}.json", details)
+-        print(details["traceback"], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+-        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
+-            child.terminate(); child.wait()
+-        return 130 if isinstance(error, KeyboardInterrupt) else 1
+-    finally:
+-        if locked:
+-            try:
+-                lock.unlink()
+-            except OSError as error:
+-                write_independent_logs(folders, f"잠금정리오류_{stamp}.json", exception_payload(error))
+-
+-
+-def main():
+-    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="검증한 5차 복구 상태로 학습을 이어갑니다.")
+-    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=("cuda", "cpu"), default="cuda")
+-    parser.add_argument("--baseline-sha256", help="사전에 고정·검토한 비공개 원본 기준의 SHA256")
+-    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
+-    args = parser.parse_args()
+-    if args.worker:
+-        try:
+-            authorized = worker_parent_authorized(os.environ.get("CT_RECOVERY_SUPERVISOR_PID"))
+-        except Exception as error:
+-            parser.error("worker 감독 연결을 확인하지 못했습니다: " + str(error))
+-        if not authorized:
+-            parser.error("worker는 사전 검사를 통과한 감독 프로세스에서만 시작합니다.")
+-    if not args.worker and (not args.baseline_sha256 or len(args.baseline_sha256) != 64
+-                            or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in args.baseline_sha256)):
+-        parser.error("사전에 고정한 소문자 SHA256 64자리를 명시해야 합니다.")
+-    return worker(ROOT, args.device, log_folders(ROOT)) if args.worker else supervise(ROOT, args.device, args.baseline_sha256)
+````
+
+## tools/데이터_원인감사.py
+
+이전 0 B / SHA-256 `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`. 이후 20,841 B / SHA-256 `bac75d84bce113176db3641060bef921e6455e3f7e018115c6fb26d1cdc435d0`.
+
+````diff
+--- 이전/tools/데이터_원인감사.py
++++ 이후/tools/데이터_원인감사.py
+@@ -0,0 +1,284 @@
++"""보존한 원영상·분할을 읽어 저차원 단서와 중복 경계를 탐색합니다."""
++
++import argparse
++from collections import Counter
++from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
++import hashlib
++import io
++import json
++import math
++import os
++from pathlib import Path
++import sys
++import time
++import traceback
++import warnings
++
++os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "1")
++os.environ.setdefault("OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "1")
++os.environ.setdefault("MKL_NUM_THREADS", "1")
++
++import numpy as np
++import PIL
++from PIL import Image
++import scipy
++from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
++from scipy.sparse.csgraph import connected_components
++from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
++import sklearn
++from sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning
++from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
++from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score
++from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
++from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
++from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
++
++
++PERCENTILES = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95, 99]
++FEATURE_NAMES = ["mean", "std_ddof0", "min", "max"] + [f"p{x}" for x in PERCENTILES] + [f"hist_{x:02d}" for x in range(32)]
++SPLITS = ["train", "validation", "test"]
++
++
++def kst():
++    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=9))).isoformat()
++
++
++def sha(raw):
++    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
++
++
++def save(path, report):
++    path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
++
++
++def statistics(pixels):
++    """촬영 크기·파일명·폴더 라벨을 입력하지 않고 픽셀 분포만 요약합니다."""
++    x = np.asarray(pixels, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(-1)
++    histogram = np.histogram(x, bins=32, range=(0, 256))[0].astype(np.float64) / len(x)
++    summary = np.array([x.mean(), x.std(ddof=0), x.min(), x.max()], dtype=np.float64) / 255.0
++    percentiles = np.percentile(x, PERCENTILES, method="linear") / 255.0
++    return np.concatenate([summary, percentiles, histogram])
++
++
++def border_pixels(pixels):
++    """원해상도 가로·세로 각각 바깥쪽 5%를 모서리 중복 없이 사용합니다."""
++    height, width = pixels.shape
++    by, bx = max(1, math.ceil(height * 0.05)), max(1, math.ceil(width * 0.05))
++    mask = np.ones((height, width), dtype=bool)
++    mask[by:height - by, bx:width - bx] = False
++    return pixels[mask]
++
++
++def metrics(y, predicted, scores):
++    matrix = confusion_matrix(y, predicted, labels=[0, 1])
++    tn, fp, fn, tp = [int(x) for x in matrix.ravel()]
++    correct = tn + tp
++    total = len(y)
++    return {"correct": correct, "total": total, "accuracy": correct / total,
++            "accuracy_percent_rounded": f"{100 * correct / total:.1f}%", "auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, scores)),
++            "confusion_matrix": matrix.tolist(), "sensitivity": tp / (tp + fn), "specificity": tn / (tn + fp)}
++
++
++def fit_experiment(features, labels, indices, fit_labels):
++    """표준화와 분류기 학습 모두 train 원본에만 적합합니다."""
++    pipe = Pipeline([("scale", StandardScaler()), ("logreg", LogisticRegression(C=1.0, random_state=42, max_iter=2000,
++                                                                                 solver="lbfgs", tol=1e-4, class_weight=None))])
++    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
++        warnings.simplefilter("always", ConvergenceWarning)
++        pipe.fit(features[indices["train"]], fit_labels)
++    warnings_text = [str(x.message) for x in caught]
++    result = {"feature_count": features.shape[1], "fit_count": int(pipe.named_steps["scale"].n_samples_seen_),
++              "fit_n_iter": pipe.named_steps["logreg"].n_iter_.tolist(), "warnings": warnings_text,
++              "converged": not any(issubclass(x.category, ConvergenceWarning) for x in caught),
++              "scaler_mean_sha256": sha(pipe.named_steps["scale"].mean_.astype("<f8").tobytes()),
++              "scaler_var_sha256": sha(pipe.named_steps["scale"].var_.astype("<f8").tobytes()),
++              "train_only_scaler_mean_matches": bool(np.allclose(pipe.named_steps["scale"].mean_, features[indices["train"]].mean(axis=0), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15)),
++              "evaluation": {}}
++    for split in SPLITS:
++        ix = indices[split]
++        scores = pipe.decision_function(features[ix])
++        predicted = (scores > 0.0).astype(int)
++        result["evaluation"][split] = metrics(labels[ix], predicted, scores)
++    return result
++
++
++def self_check():
++    image = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=np.uint8)
++    image[5:95, 5:95] = 255
++    assert len(border_pixels(image)) == 1900 and np.max(border_pixels(image)) == 0
++    stats = statistics(np.array([0, 255], dtype=np.uint8))
++    assert len(stats) == 45 and stats[0] == 0.5 and np.isclose(stats[13:].sum(), 1)
++    result = metrics(np.array([0, 0, 1, 1]), np.array([0, 1, 0, 1]), np.array([-2., 1., -1., 2.]))
++    assert result["confusion_matrix"] == [[1, 1], [1, 1]] and result["correct"] == 2 and result["auc"] == 0.75
++    print(json.dumps({"self_check": "PASS", "checks": 3}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
++
++
++def execute(args, report, output):
++    started = time.monotonic()
++    source = Path(args.source_root).resolve()
++    manifest_path = source / "work/results/dataset_manifest_private.json"
++    raw_manifest = manifest_path.read_bytes()
++    manifest = json.loads(raw_manifest.decode("utf-8", errors="strict"))
++    rows = manifest["records"]
++    required = {"path", "relative_path", "source_class", "label", "byte_sha256", "pixel_sha256", "width", "height", "similarity_descriptor_sha256", "exact_duplicate_group", "similarity_group"}
++    assert all(required <= set(row) for row in rows), "원본 manifest 스키마 누락"
++    assert len(rows) == 1097 and set(manifest["splits"]) == set(SPLITS), "원본 수·분할이 승인 범위와 다름"
++    guard_paths = [source / "config.json", source / "run_training.py", *sorted((source / "src").glob("*.py")), source / "work/runtime/status.json", manifest_path]
++    guard_before = {str(p.relative_to(source)): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in guard_paths}
++    report.update(status="실행중", started_at_kst=kst(), actual_argv=sys.orig_argv, cwd=str(Path.cwd()),
++                  executor_role="새 감사실행기 구현자; 자기 독립검증·중앙영수증 아님", source_root=str(source),
++                  source_manifest={"bytes": len(raw_manifest), "file_sha256": sha(raw_manifest), "manifest_sha256": manifest["manifest_sha256"]},
++                  schema={"root_fields": list(manifest), "record_fields": sorted(required)},
++                  script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), package_versions={"python": sys.version, "numpy": np.__version__, "Pillow": PIL.__version__, "scipy": scipy.__version__, "scikit_learn": sklearn.__version__},
++                  fixed_conditions={"feature_names": FEATURE_NAMES, "feature_count": len(FEATURE_NAMES), "intensity": "Pillow.convert('L'), native resolution, no augmentation", "statistics": "mean/std(ddof0)/min/max/percentiles(linear)/normalized32bins[0,256)", "border": "outer5% width+height using ceil/min1; corner pixels once", "scaler": "StandardScaler fit only train769", "logreg": {"C": 1, "solver": "lbfgs", "random_state": 42, "max_iter": 2000, "tol": 1e-4, "class_weight": None, "default_penalty": "l2"}, "prediction_threshold": "decision_function>0 (probability>0.5); exact zero→class0, sklearn binary predict rule", "shuffle_seeds": list(range(42, 52)), "grouping": "64x64 Pillow BILINEAR uint8; direct squared Euclidean float64; RMSE<=5; connected components", "tuning": "none; no validation/test fitting or parameter selection", "cpu_threads": 1},
++                  official_references=["https://scikit-learn.org/stable/common_pitfalls.html", "https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression.html"])
++    save(output, report)
++    print("원영상 무결성·통계 읽기 시작", flush=True)
++    descriptors, whole, border = [], [], []
++    actual_rows = []
++    source_sha_hasher = hashlib.sha256()
++    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
++        path = Path(row["path"])
++        raw = path.read_bytes()
++        assert sha(raw) == row["byte_sha256"], "원영상 byte SHA 불일치"
++        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as image:
++            gray = image.convert("L")
++            width, height = gray.size
++            pixels = np.asarray(gray, dtype=np.uint8)
++            pixel_sha = sha(f"L:{width}:{height}:".encode() + gray.tobytes())
++            thumb = np.asarray(gray.resize((64, 64), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR), dtype=np.uint8)
++        assert pixel_sha == row["pixel_sha256"] and (width, height) == (row["width"], row["height"]), "픽셀 SHA·크기 불일치"
++        assert sha(thumb.tobytes()) == row["similarity_descriptor_sha256"], "유사 descriptor SHA 불일치"
++        source_sha_hasher.update(row["relative_path"].encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + bytes.fromhex(sha(raw)))
++        descriptors.append(thumb.reshape(-1).astype(np.float64))
++        whole.append(statistics(pixels))
++        border.append(statistics(border_pixels(pixels)))
++        actual_rows.append({"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "byte_sha256": sha(raw), "pixel_sha256": pixel_sha})
++        if (index + 1) % 200 == 0 or index + 1 == len(rows):
++            print(f"원영상 {index + 1}/{len(rows)} 읽기 완료", flush=True)
++    names = [r["relative_path"] for r in rows]
++    assert len(set(names)) == len(names), "manifest 원본 상대경로 중복"
++    name_to_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(names)}
++    labels = np.array([r["label"] for r in rows], dtype=int)
++    assert set(labels) == {0, 1}, "이진 라벨 이외 값"
++    indices = {split: np.array([name_to_index[r["relative_path"]] for r in sorted(manifest["splits"][split], key=lambda r: r["relative_path"])], dtype=int) for split in SPLITS}
++    all_indices = [int(i) for values in indices.values() for i in values]
++    assert len(all_indices) == len(rows) and len(set(all_indices)) == len(rows), "분할 누락·중복"
++    for split in SPLITS:
++        assert all(r == rows[name_to_index[r["relative_path"]]] for r in manifest["splits"][split]), "분할 행과 원본 행 불일치"
++    assert [len(indices[s]) for s in SPLITS] == [769, 164, 164], "분할 수 불일치"
++    split_summary = {}
++    for split in SPLITS:
++        split_rows = [rows[i] for i in indices[split]]
++        counts = Counter(r["label"] for r in split_rows)
++        split_summary[split] = {"total": len(split_rows), "OK": counts[0], "NG": counts[1], "source_class": dict(Counter(r["source_class"] for r in split_rows))}
++    print("64픽셀 직접 거리와 연결성분 계산", flush=True)
++    descriptors = np.asarray(descriptors)
++    distance_squared = cdist(descriptors, descriptors, metric="sqeuclidean")
++    n_components, components = connected_components(csr_matrix(distance_squared <= 25 * 4096), directed=False)
++    group_id = {int(c): min(rows[i]["pixel_sha256"] for i in np.flatnonzero(components == c)) for c in np.unique(components)}
++    actual_groups = [group_id[int(c)] for c in components]
++    group_match = all(g == row["similarity_group"] for g, row in zip(actual_groups, rows))
++    assert group_match, "독립 연결성분과 manifest 유사그룹 불일치"
++    assert all(len(set(labels[components == c])) == 1 for c in np.unique(components)), "유사그룹 라벨 충돌"
++    cross_overlap = {}
++    for left, right in [("train", "validation"), ("train", "test"), ("validation", "test")]:
++        values = {}
++        for key in ["relative_path", "byte_sha256", "pixel_sha256", "exact_duplicate_group", "similarity_group"]:
++            values[key] = len({rows[i][key] for i in indices[left]} & {rows[i][key] for i in indices[right]})
++        values["independent_similarity_components"] = len({actual_groups[i] for i in indices[left]} & {actual_groups[i] for i in indices[right]})
++        cross_overlap[left + "__" + right] = values
++    assert all(value == 0 for pair in cross_overlap.values() for value in pair.values()), "분할간 교차 겹침 발견"
++    nearest = {}
++    for split in ["validation", "test"]:
++        distances = distance_squared[np.ix_(indices[split], indices["train"])]
++        closest = distances.argmin(axis=1)
++        nearest_sq = distances[np.arange(len(closest)), closest]
++        rmse = np.sqrt(nearest_sq / 4096)
++        predicted = labels[indices["train"]][closest]
++        nearest[split] = {"rmse_min": float(rmse.min()), "rmse_median": float(np.median(rmse)), "rmse_max": float(rmse.max()),
++                          "count_le_5": int((rmse <= 5).sum()), "count_le_10": int((rmse <= 10).sum()), "count_le_15": int((rmse <= 15).sum()),

++def reference_blur(array, sigma):
++    # 기존 Torch FFT 구현을 호출하지 않는 독립 SciPy 식입니다.
++    value = np.asarray(array, dtype=np.float64)
++    height, width = value.shape[-2:]
++    y = np.arange(height, dtype=np.float64) * np.pi / height
++    x = np.arange(width, dtype=np.float64) * np.pi / width
++    transfer = np.exp(-0.5 * float(sigma) ** 2 * (y[:, None] ** 2 + x[None, :] ** 2))
++    return idctn(dctn(value, type=2, axes=(-2, -1), norm="ortho") * transfer,
++                 type=2, axes=(-2, -1), norm="ortho")
++
++
++def math_checks(device="cpu"):
++    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
++    rows = []
++    for height, width in [(17, 19), (256, 256)]:
++        impulse = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=np.float32)
++        impulse[height // 2, width // 2] = 1
++        signals = [("constant", np.full((height, width), 2.5, np.float32), None),
++                   ("impulse", impulse, None),
++                   ("random", rng.normal(size=(height, width)).astype(np.float32), None)]
++        for ky, kx in [(1, 0), (0, 1), (3, 4), (height // 2, 0)]:
++            mode = (np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(height)[:, None] + 0.5) * ky / height)
++                    * np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(width)[None, :] + 0.5) * kx / width)).astype(np.float32)
++            signals.append((f"cosine_{ky}_{kx}", mode, (ky, kx)))
++        for name, signal, mode in signals:
++            tensor = torch.tensor(signal[None, None], device=device)
++            for sigma in SIGMAS:
++                with torch.inference_mode():
++                    actual = GaussianDCTBlur(sigma).to(device)(tensor).cpu().numpy()[0, 0].astype(np.float64)
++                reference = reference_blur(signal, sigma)
++                maximum_error = float(np.max(np.abs(actual - reference)))
++                mean_error = abs(float(actual.mean() - signal.astype(np.float64).mean()))
++                tolerance = 3e-5 * max(1.0, float(np.abs(signal).max()))
++                if maximum_error > tolerance or mean_error > tolerance:
++                    raise AssertionError(f"독립 DCT 대조 실패: {device}/{height}x{width}/{name}/{sigma}, {maximum_error}, {mean_error}")
++                expected_gain = actual_gain = gain_error = None
++                if mode is not None:
++                    ky, kx = mode
++                    expected_gain = math.exp(-0.5 * sigma ** 2 * math.pi ** 2 * ((ky / height) ** 2 + (kx / width) ** 2))
++                    signal64 = signal.astype(np.float64)
++                    actual_gain = float(np.sum(actual * signal64) / np.sum(signal64 ** 2))
++                    gain_error = abs(actual_gain - expected_gain)
++                    if gain_error > 3e-5:
++                        raise AssertionError("코사인 주파수 이득이 사전 명세와 다릅니다.")
++                rows.append({"device": device, "height": height, "width": width, "signal": name, "sigma": sigma,
++                             "max_abs_error": maximum_error, "mean_abs_error": mean_error, "tolerance": tolerance,
++                             "expected_gain": expected_gain, "actual_gain": actual_gain, "gain_abs_error": gain_error})
++    if len(rows) != 70:
++        raise AssertionError("수학 검사 조건 수가70이 아닙니다.")
++    return {"n_cases": len(rows), "device": device, "max_abs_error": max(row["max_abs_error"] for row in rows),
++            "max_mean_abs_error": max(row["mean_abs_error"] for row in rows), "cases": rows}
++
++
++def metric_values(labels, logits, probabilities=None):
++    y = np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64)
++    z = np.asarray(logits, dtype=np.float64)
++    p = expit(z) if probabilities is None else np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=np.float64)
++    if not np.isfinite(z).all() or not np.isfinite(p).all() or y.shape != z.shape or y.shape != p.shape:
++        raise ValueError("라벨·로짓·확률의 shape 또는 유한성이 잘못됐습니다.")
++    predicted = (z >= 0).astype(np.int64)
++    matrix = [[int(np.sum((y == a) & (predicted == b))) for b in (0, 1)] for a in (0, 1)]
++    correct = int(np.sum(y == predicted))
++    return {"correct": correct, "n_images": len(y), "accuracy": correct / len(y),
++            "auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, z)), "confusion_matrix": matrix,
++            "loss": float(np.logaddexp(0, -(2 * y - 1) * z).mean()),
++            "logit_min": float(z.min()), "logit_max": float(z.max()),
++            "threshold": 0.5, "logit_threshold": 0.0,
++            "threshold_rounding_differences": int(np.sum(predicted != (p >= 0.5).astype(np.int64)))}
++
++
++def prediction_rows(records, logits, probabilities):

++        raise ValueError("예측 CSV의 원본 목록·값 수가 다릅니다.")
++    return [{"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "label": row["label"], "logit": float(logit),
++             "ng_probability": float(probability), "prediction": int(logit >= 0),
++             "probability_prediction": int(probability >= 0.5)}
++            for row, logit, probability in zip(records, logits, probabilities)]
++
++
++def load_model(sigma, device):
++    path = CHECKPOINTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_best.pt"
++    baseline = read_json(BASELINE)
++    known = {item["path"]: item["sha256"] for item in baseline["source_files"]}
++    if str(path) not in known or digest(path) != known[str(path)]:
++        raise ValueError("알려진 최초 SHA의 로컬 체크포인트만 읽을 수 있습니다.")
++    saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
++    metrics = read_json(RESULTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_metrics.json")
++    if saved["run_id"] != RUN_ID or saved["sigma"] != sigma or saved["epoch"] != metrics["best_epoch"]:
++        raise ValueError("체크포인트의 실행·강도·선정 epoch가 기존 지표와 다릅니다.")
++    model = SplitResNet50(sigma=sigma, pretrained=False).eval()
++    model.load_state_dict(saved["model"], strict=True)
++    return model.to(device), {"sigma": sigma, "epoch": saved["epoch"], "sha256": known[str(path)], "weights_only": True}
++
++
++def infer(model, records, device):
++    dataset = CTDataset(records, image_size=512, training=False)
++    loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
++    logits, probabilities = [], []
++    with torch.inference_mode():
++        for images, _ in loader:
++            values = model(images.to(device).float()).double()
++            logits.extend(values.cpu().tolist())
++            probabilities.extend(values.sigmoid().cpu().tolist())
++    return logits, probabilities
++
++
++def compare_original(sigma, records, logits, probabilities):
++    original = csv_rows(RESULTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_test_predictions_private.csv")
++    if len(original) != len(records):
++        raise AssertionError("원 CSV와 재추론 표본 수가 다릅니다.")
++    if any(a["relative_path"] != b["relative_path"] or int(a["label"]) != b["label"] for a, b in zip(original, records)):
++        raise AssertionError("원 CSV와 재추론 순서·라벨이 다릅니다.")
++    old = np.asarray([float(row["ng_probability"]) for row in original])
++    new = np.asarray(probabilities)
++    prediction_mismatches = int(np.sum((old >= .5) != (np.asarray(logits) >= 0)))
++    result = {"max_probability_abs_difference": float(np.max(np.abs(old - new))),
++              "probabilities_within_prespecified_tolerance": bool(np.allclose(old, new, atol=2e-7, rtol=2e-5)),
++              "prediction_mismatches": prediction_mismatches,
++              "original_correct": int(np.sum((old >= .5) == np.asarray([row["label"] for row in records]))),
++              "original_csv_has_logits": False}
++    if prediction_mismatches or not result["probabilities_within_prespecified_tolerance"]:
++        raise AssertionError("기존 CSV 확률·정답 재현이 사전 허용 범위를 벗어났습니다: " + json.dumps(result))
++    return result
++
++
++def cross_sigma(model, records, device, destination):
++    # 각 모듈을 새로 만들어 강도 변경 때 기존 transfer 캐시를 재사용하지 않습니다.
++    blurs = {sigma: GaussianDCTBlur(sigma).to(device) for sigma in SIGMAS}
++    predictions = {sigma: {"logits": [], "probabilities": []} for sigma in SIGMAS}
++    statistics = []
++    dataset = CTDataset(records, image_size=512, training=False)
++    loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
++    offset = 0
++    with torch.inference_mode():
++        for images, _ in loader:
++            images = images.to(device).float()
++            features = model.edge((images - model.rgb_mean) / model.rgb_std)
++            source64 = features.double()
++            means = source64.mean(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True)
++            base_ac = ((source64 - means) ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
++            base_total = (source64 ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
++            for sigma, blur in blurs.items():
++                transmitted = blur(features)
++                logits64 = model.cloud(transmitted).double()
++                predictions[sigma]["logits"].extend(logits64.cpu().tolist())
++                predictions[sigma]["probabilities"].extend(logits64.sigmoid().cpu().tolist())
++                value64 = transmitted.double()
++                new_means = value64.mean(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True)
++                ac = ((value64 - new_means) ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
++                mse = ((value64 - source64) ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
++                arrays = {"base_ac_energy": base_ac, "ac_energy": ac,
++                          "ac_retention_ratio": ac / base_ac,
++                          "dc_energy": (new_means ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3)),
++                          "total_energy": (value64 ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3)),
++                          "relative_squared_change": mse / base_total,
++                          "mse_from_unblurred": mse,
++                          "max_channel_mean_abs_difference": (new_means - means).abs().amax(dim=(1, 2, 3))}
++                arrays = {name: values.cpu().tolist() for name, values in arrays.items()}
++                for index in range(len(images)):
++                    row = records[offset + index]
++                    statistics.append({"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "label": row["label"], "sigma": sigma,
++                                       **{name: values[index] for name, values in arrays.items()}})
++            offset += len(images)
++            if offset == 8 or offset % 40 == 0 or offset == len(records):
++                progress("cross_sigma", completed_images=offset, total_images=len(records))
++    summary = {}
++    for sigma in SIGMAS:
++        selected = [row for row in statistics if row["sigma"] == sigma]
++        summary[str(sigma)] = {key: float(np.mean([row[key] for row in selected])) for key in selected[0]
++                               if key not in {"relative_path", "label", "sigma"}}
++        summary[str(sigma)]["maximum_channel_mean_error"] = max(row["max_channel_mean_abs_difference"] for row in selected)
++    save_csv(destination / "CT특징_공간통계_비공개.csv", statistics)
++    return predictions, summary
++
++
++def dc_experiment(model, splits, device, destination):
++    descriptors, labels = {}, {}
++    for name in ["train", "validation", "test"]:
++        loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(CTDataset(splits[name], image_size=512, training=False),
++                                             batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
++        values, targets = [], []
++        with torch.inference_mode():
++            for images, target in loader:
++                features = model.edge((images.to(device).float() - model.rgb_mean) / model.rgb_std)
++                values.append(features.double().mean(dim=(-2, -1)).cpu().numpy())
++                targets.extend(target.int().tolist())
++        descriptors[name] = np.concatenate(values, axis=0)
++        labels[name] = np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.int64)
++        progress("dc_extraction", split=name, n_images=len(targets), n_features=64)
++    scaler = StandardScaler()
++    scaled_train = scaler.fit_transform(descriptors["train"])
++    classifier = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42)
++    # validation/test 정보는 fit·표준화 추정·설정 선택에 사용하지 않습니다.
++    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as captured:
++        warnings.simplefilter("always")
++        classifier.fit(scaled_train, labels["train"])
++    if captured or int(classifier.n_iter_.max()) >= 2000:
++        diagnostic = {"n_iter": classifier.n_iter_.tolist(), "warnings": [str(item.message) for item in captured]}
++        save_json(destination / "DC분류기_수렴진단_비공개.json", diagnostic)
++        raise RuntimeError("DC 분류기의 수렴 경고 또는 반복 상한 도달: " + json.dumps(diagnostic, ensure_ascii=False))
++    reports = {}
++    for name in ["train", "validation", "test"]:
++        transformed = scaler.transform(descriptors[name])
++        logits = classifier.decision_function(transformed)
++        probabilities = classifier.predict_proba(transformed)[:, 1]
++        reports[name] = metric_values(labels[name], logits, probabilities)
++        save_csv(destination / f"DC평균64_{name}_예측_비공개.csv",
++                 prediction_rows(splits[name], logits, probabilities))
++        save_csv(destination / f"DC평균64_{name}_특징_비공개.csv",
++                 [{"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "label": row["label"],
++                   **{f"channel_{channel}": float(value) for channel, value in enumerate(vector)}}
++                  for row, vector in zip(splits[name], descriptors[name])])
++    reports.update(n_features=64, fit_split="train", scaler_fit_split="train", n_fit=769,
++                   parameters={"C": 1.0, "solver": "lbfgs", "max_iter": 2000, "tol": 1e-4, "seed": 42},
++                   n_iter=classifier.n_iter_.tolist(), warnings=[str(item.message) for item in captured],
++                   scaler_mean=scaler.mean_.tolist(), scaler_scale=scaler.scale_.tolist(),
++                   coefficients=classifier.coef_.tolist(), intercept=classifier.intercept_.tolist())
++    return reports
++

++        raise RuntimeError("확인한 CUDA 장치를 사용할 수 없습니다. CPU로 자동 대체하지 않습니다.")

+-  catch { $('alert').className='alert visible failed';$('alert').textContent='상태 서버에 연결할 수 없습니다. 마지막 관측값을 표시합니다. 세션 URL과 서버 실행 상태를 확인해 주세요.';pipeline?.setStatus(0,'failed',false); }
+-  finally {refreshing=false;}
+-}
+-$('scene').addEventListener('ct-sigma-select',event=>{if(event.detail?.run_id===selectionRun)selectSigma(event.detail.sigma);});
+-$('refresh').addEventListener('click',refresh);
+-window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(latest)drawChart({sigma:selectedSigma,history:selectedResult?.history||[]});});
+-for(const link of document.querySelectorAll('nav a'))link.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelector('nav .active')?.classList.remove('active');link.classList.add('active');});
+-refresh();setInterval(refresh,3000);
+````

+-  workspace.querySelector('.pipeline-learning')?.remove();
+-  workspace.querySelector('.pipeline-technical')?.remove();
+-  workspace.querySelector('.pipeline-gallery')?.remove();
+-  let viewport=canvas.parentElement;
+-  if(!viewport.classList.contains('pipeline-viewport')){
+-    viewport=document.createElement('div');viewport.className='pipeline-viewport';canvas.before(viewport);viewport.append(canvas);
+-  }
+-  viewport.removeAttribute('tabindex');viewport.setAttribute('role','img');
+-  viewport.setAttribute('aria-label','실제 영상이 아닌 처리 순서 안내: CT 입력, 특징맵 64개 추출, 특징에만 블러, OK와 NG 분류');

+-  const guide=document.createElement('section');guide.className='pipeline-guide';guide.setAttribute('aria-label','무엇을 학습하는 실험인가요');
+-  function easyText(node,text){const space=text.indexOf(' ');if(space>0&&/\p{Extended_Pictographic}/u.test(text.slice(0,space))){const icon=document.createElement('span');icon.className='pipeline-emoji';icon.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');icon.textContent=text.slice(0,space);node.replaceChildren(icon,document.createTextNode(text.slice(space)));}else node.textContent=text;}
+-  const core=document.createElement('p');core.className='pipeline-core';easyText(core,'💡 원본 사진은 그대로 둡니다. 사진에서 찾은 선과 무늬만 부드럽게 바꿔 비교해요.');guide.append(core);
+-  const list=document.createElement('ol');list.className='pipeline-cards';guide.append(list);
+-  const definitions=[
+-    ['📷 ① 몸속 사진 넣기','CT는 몸속을 찍은 사진이에요. 원본 사진은 바꾸지 않아요.','원본은 그대로'],
+-    ['🔎 ② 선·무늬 찾기','서로 다른 돋보기 64개로 보는 것과 비슷해요. 사진 한 장에서 특징 그림 64개가 나와요.','돋보기는 이해를 돕는 비유'],
+-    ['🌫️ ③ 무늬 부드럽게','찾아낸 선과 무늬의 경계를 흐리게 해요. 원본 CT를 흐리는 것은 아니에요.','숫자가 클수록 더 부드럽게'],
+-    ['🗂️ ④ 두 묶음으로 나누기','자료의 이름에 따라 정상·양성은 OK, 악성은 NG로 나누도록 배워요.','OK·NG는 자료의 분류 이름']
