++
++def windows_process(pid):
++    """숫자로 확인한 단일 PID의 부모와 실행파일만 읽습니다."""
++    if type(pid) is not int or pid <= 0:
++        raise ValueError("유효한 프로세스 PID가 필요합니다.")
++    command = ("$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); "
++               f"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId = {pid}' | "
++               "Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
++    result = subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", command],
++                            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="strict", timeout=20,
++                            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0))
++    if result.returncode:
++        raise RuntimeError("worker 감독 연결 조회 실패: " + result.stderr)
++    return json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout.strip() else None
++
++
++def worker_parent_authorized(supervisor_pid):
++    """직접 감독 또는 그 감독이 만든 동일 venv launcher 한 단계만 허용합니다."""
++    if (not isinstance(supervisor_pid, str) or not supervisor_pid.isascii()
++            or not supervisor_pid.isdecimal() or int(supervisor_pid) <= 0):
++        return False
++    supervisor_pid = int(supervisor_pid)
++    parent_pid = os.getppid()
++    if parent_pid == supervisor_pid:
++        return True
++    if os.name != "nt":
++        return False
++    launcher = windows_process(parent_pid)
++    if (not isinstance(launcher, dict) or launcher.get("ProcessId") != parent_pid
++            or launcher.get("ParentProcessId") != supervisor_pid
++            or not isinstance(launcher.get("ExecutablePath"), str)):
++        return False
++    normalize = lambda path: os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path))
++    return normalize(launcher["ExecutablePath"]) == normalize(sys.executable)
++
++
++def windows_arguments(command_line):
++    """Windows의 실제 따옴표 규칙으로 명령행을 분리하며 작업 폴더는 추측하지 않습니다."""
++    from ctypes import wintypes
++    count = ctypes.c_int()
++    parse = ctypes.WinDLL("shell32", use_last_error=True).CommandLineToArgvW
++    parse.argtypes = [wintypes.LPCWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
++    parse.restype = ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.LPWSTR)
++    arguments = parse(command_line, ctypes.byref(count))
++    if not arguments:
++        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
++    release = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True).LocalFree
++    release.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
++    release.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
++    try:
++        return [arguments[index] for index in range(count.value)]
++    finally:
++        release(ctypes.cast(arguments, ctypes.c_void_p))
++
++
++def training_processes(project_root):
++    if os.name != "nt":
++        raise RuntimeError("이 복구 실행의 중복 확인은 Windows CIM에서만 지원합니다.")
++    command = "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^python(w)?(.exe)?$' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
++    result = subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", command],
++                            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="strict", timeout=20,
++                            creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0))
++    if result.returncode:
++        raise RuntimeError("학습 중복 조회 실패: " + result.stderr)
++    rows = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout.strip() else []
++    if isinstance(rows, dict):
++        rows = [rows]
++    own_pid, parent_pid = os.getpid(), os.getppid()
++    own = [row for row in rows if row.get("ProcessId") == own_pid]
++    if len(own) != 1 or own[0].get("ParentProcessId") != parent_pid:
++        raise RuntimeError("CIM에서 자기 프로세스와 실제 부모 관계를 확인하지 못했습니다.")
++    suffix = str(Path(project_root)).replace("\\", "/").lower()
++    if len(suffix) > 2 and suffix[1] == ":":
++        suffix = suffix[2:]
++    found = []
++    for row in rows:
++        command_line = row.get("CommandLine") or ""
++        if row["ProcessId"] == own_pid or not command_line:
++            continue
++        executable = row.get("ExecutablePath")
++        # 실제 부모 관계가 확인된 동일 venv launcher만 자기 실행 체인으로 제외합니다.
++        if (row["ProcessId"] == parent_pid and isinstance(executable, str)
++                and os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(executable)) == os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(sys.executable))):
++            continue
++        arguments = windows_arguments(command_line)
++        scripts = [argument for argument in arguments[1:]
++                   if ntpath.basename(argument).lower() in {"run_training.py", "복구_학습.py", "안전_학습.py"}]
++        module_call = any(value == "-m" and index + 1 < len(arguments)
++                          and arguments[index + 1] in {"run_training", "복구_학습", "안전_학습", "tools.safe_training"}
++                          for index, value in enumerate(arguments))
++        ambiguous = module_call or any(not ntpath.isabs(script) for script in scripts)
++        same_project = any(ntpath.splitdrive(script)[1].replace("\\", "/").lower().startswith(suffix.rstrip("/") + "/")
++                           for script in scripts if ntpath.isabs(script))
++        if ambiguous or same_project:
++            found.append({"pid": row["ProcessId"], "command": command_line,
++                          "reason": "상대 호출의 작업 폴더를 확인할 수 없습니다." if ambiguous else "같은 프로젝트의 학습입니다."})

++def log_folders(root):

++    return [Path(root) / "work/recovery_logs", local / "폐CT_학습복구" / "7차"]

++def worker(root, device, folders):
++    """기존 run_training.py의 오류 처리 전에 원오류를 먼저 잡는 별도 진입점입니다."""
++    os.environ.setdefault("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG", ":4096:8")
++    os.environ.setdefault("TORCH_HOME", str(Path(root) / "work/torch-cache"))
++    from src.state import StatusWriter, atomic_json
++    from src.training import run_training
++    state = None
++    try:
++        config = json.loads((Path(root) / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

++        state.update()

++    except BaseException as error:

++        details = exception_payload(error)

++        except Exception as followup:

++            except Exception as followup:
++                secondary.append(exception_payload(followup))
++        if failures or secondary:
++            write_independent_logs(folders, name, {**details, "secondary_status_errors": secondary,
++                                                   "initial_log_errors": failures})

++        return 130 if isinstance(error, KeyboardInterrupt) else 1

++def supervise(root, device, baseline_sha256):
++    root = Path(root).resolve()
++    folders = log_folders(root)
++    stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
++    lock = root / "work/runtime/recovery.lock"
++    child = None
++    locked = False
++    try:
++        storage = {"training_free": require_free_space(root, MIN_TRAIN_FREE),
++                   "independent_log_free": require_free_space(folders[1], MIN_LOG_FREE)}
++        if root.anchor.lower() == folders[1].anchor.lower():
++            raise ValueError("독립 오류 로그는 학습과 다른 볼륨이어야 합니다.")
++        reject_duplicates(training_processes(root.parent))
++        from tools.inputs import verify_training_inputs
++        recovery = verify_training_inputs(root, baseline_sha256)
++        lock.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
++        descriptor = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
++        locked = True
++        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
++            json.dump({"pid": os.getpid(), "time": stamp, **storage, **recovery}, stream, ensure_ascii=False)
++        argv = [sys.executable, "-B", "-X", "utf8", "-u", str(root / "안전_학습.py"), "--worker", "--device", device]
++        errors = write_independent_logs(folders, f"실행_{stamp}.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), **storage, **recovery})
++        if errors:
++            raise OSError("학습 시작 전 두 볼륨의 독립 로그를 모두 만들지 못했습니다.")
++        environment = dict(os.environ, CT_RECOVERY_SUPERVISOR_PID=str(os.getpid()))

++                                 creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0))
++        log_errors = []
++
++        def pump(pipe, kind):
++            streams = []
++            for folder in folders:
++                try:
++                    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
++                    streams.append((folder, (folder / f"학습_{stamp}.{kind}.log").open("xb")))
++                except Exception as error:
++                    log_errors.append(exception_payload(error))
++            try:
++                for block in iter(lambda: pipe.read1(4096), b""):
++                    for folder, stream in list(streams):
++                        try:
++                            stream.write(block); stream.flush()
++                        except Exception as error:
++                            log_errors.append({"folder": str(folder), **exception_payload(error)})
++                            streams.remove((folder, stream)); stream.close()
++                    target = sys.stderr if kind == "stderr" else sys.stdout
++                    try:
++                        target.buffer.write(block); target.buffer.flush()
++                    except (OSError, AttributeError):
++                        pass
++            finally:
++                pipe.close()
++                for _folder, stream in streams:
++                    stream.close()
++
++        pumps = [threading.Thread(target=pump, args=(child.stdout, "stdout")),
++                 threading.Thread(target=pump, args=(child.stderr, "stderr"))]
++        for thread in pumps:
++            thread.start()
++        code = child.wait()
++        for thread in pumps:
++            thread.join()
++        write_independent_logs(folders, f"종료_{stamp}.json", {"exit_code": code, "child_pid": child.pid,
++                                                           "time_kst": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), "secondary_stream_errors": log_errors})
++        return code
++    except BaseException as error:
++        details = exception_payload(error)
++        write_independent_logs(folders, f"실행경계오류_{stamp}.json", details)
++        print(details["traceback"], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
++        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
++            child.terminate(); child.wait()
++        return 130 if isinstance(error, KeyboardInterrupt) else 1
++    finally:
++        if locked:
++            try:
++                lock.unlink()
++            except OSError as error:
++                write_independent_logs(folders, f"잠금정리오류_{stamp}.json", exception_payload(error))

++def main():

++    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
++    args = parser.parse_args()
++    if args.worker:
++        try:
++            authorized = worker_parent_authorized(os.environ.get("CT_RECOVERY_SUPERVISOR_PID"))
++        except Exception as error:
++            parser.error("worker 감독 연결을 확인하지 못했습니다: " + str(error))
++        if not authorized:
++            parser.error("worker는 사전 검사를 통과한 감독 프로세스에서만 시작합니다.")
++    if not args.worker and (not args.baseline_sha256 or len(args.baseline_sha256) != 64
++                            or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in args.baseline_sha256)):
++        parser.error("사전에 고정한 소문자 SHA256 64자리를 명시해야 합니다.")
++    return worker(ROOT, args.device, log_folders(ROOT)) if args.worker else supervise(ROOT, args.device, args.baseline_sha256)

+-"""보존한 원영상·분할을 읽어 저차원 단서와 중복 경계를 탐색합니다."""
+-
+-import argparse

+-
+-
+-PERCENTILES = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95, 99]
+-FEATURE_NAMES = ["mean", "std_ddof0", "min", "max"] + [f"p{x}" for x in PERCENTILES] + [f"hist_{x:02d}" for x in range(32)]
+-SPLITS = ["train", "validation", "test"]
+-
+-
+-def kst():
+-    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=9))).isoformat()
+-
+-
+-def sha(raw):
+-    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+-
+-
+-def save(path, report):
+-    path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
+-
+-
+-def statistics(pixels):
+-    """촬영 크기·파일명·폴더 라벨을 입력하지 않고 픽셀 분포만 요약합니다."""
+-    x = np.asarray(pixels, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(-1)
+-    histogram = np.histogram(x, bins=32, range=(0, 256))[0].astype(np.float64) / len(x)
+-    summary = np.array([x.mean(), x.std(ddof=0), x.min(), x.max()], dtype=np.float64) / 255.0
+-    percentiles = np.percentile(x, PERCENTILES, method="linear") / 255.0
+-    return np.concatenate([summary, percentiles, histogram])
+-
+-
+-def border_pixels(pixels):
+-    """원해상도 가로·세로 각각 바깥쪽 5%를 모서리 중복 없이 사용합니다."""
+-    height, width = pixels.shape
+-    by, bx = max(1, math.ceil(height * 0.05)), max(1, math.ceil(width * 0.05))
+-    mask = np.ones((height, width), dtype=bool)
+-    mask[by:height - by, bx:width - bx] = False
+-    return pixels[mask]
+-
+-
+-def metrics(y, predicted, scores):
+-    matrix = confusion_matrix(y, predicted, labels=[0, 1])
+-    tn, fp, fn, tp = [int(x) for x in matrix.ravel()]
+-    correct = tn + tp
+-    total = len(y)
+-    return {"correct": correct, "total": total, "accuracy": correct / total,
+-            "accuracy_percent_rounded": f"{100 * correct / total:.1f}%", "auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, scores)),
+-            "confusion_matrix": matrix.tolist(), "sensitivity": tp / (tp + fn), "specificity": tn / (tn + fp)}
+-
+-
+-def fit_experiment(features, labels, indices, fit_labels):
+-    """표준화와 분류기 학습 모두 train 원본에만 적합합니다."""
+-    pipe = Pipeline([("scale", StandardScaler()), ("logreg", LogisticRegression(C=1.0, random_state=42, max_iter=2000,
+-                                                                                 solver="lbfgs", tol=1e-4, class_weight=None))])
+-    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
+-        warnings.simplefilter("always", ConvergenceWarning)
+-        pipe.fit(features[indices["train"]], fit_labels)
+-    warnings_text = [str(x.message) for x in caught]
+-    result = {"feature_count": features.shape[1], "fit_count": int(pipe.named_steps["scale"].n_samples_seen_),
+-              "fit_n_iter": pipe.named_steps["logreg"].n_iter_.tolist(), "warnings": warnings_text,
+-              "converged": not any(issubclass(x.category, ConvergenceWarning) for x in caught),
+-              "scaler_mean_sha256": sha(pipe.named_steps["scale"].mean_.astype("<f8").tobytes()),
+-              "scaler_var_sha256": sha(pipe.named_steps["scale"].var_.astype("<f8").tobytes()),
+-              "train_only_scaler_mean_matches": bool(np.allclose(pipe.named_steps["scale"].mean_, features[indices["train"]].mean(axis=0), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15)),
+-              "evaluation": {}}
+-    for split in SPLITS:
+-        ix = indices[split]
+-        scores = pipe.decision_function(features[ix])
+-        predicted = (scores > 0.0).astype(int)
+-        result["evaluation"][split] = metrics(labels[ix], predicted, scores)
+-    return result
+-
+-
+-def self_check():
+-    image = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=np.uint8)
+-    image[5:95, 5:95] = 255
+-    assert len(border_pixels(image)) == 1900 and np.max(border_pixels(image)) == 0
+-    stats = statistics(np.array([0, 255], dtype=np.uint8))
+-    assert len(stats) == 45 and stats[0] == 0.5 and np.isclose(stats[13:].sum(), 1)
+-    result = metrics(np.array([0, 0, 1, 1]), np.array([0, 1, 0, 1]), np.array([-2., 1., -1., 2.]))
+-    assert result["confusion_matrix"] == [[1, 1], [1, 1]] and result["correct"] == 2 and result["auc"] == 0.75
+-    print(json.dumps({"self_check": "PASS", "checks": 3}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+-
+-

+-    guard_before = {str(p.relative_to(source)): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in guard_paths}
+-    report.update(status="실행중", started_at_kst=kst(), actual_argv=sys.orig_argv, cwd=str(Path.cwd()),

+-                  schema={"root_fields": list(manifest), "record_fields": sorted(required)},
+-                  script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), package_versions={"python": sys.version, "numpy": np.__version__, "Pillow": PIL.__version__, "scipy": scipy.__version__, "scikit_learn": sklearn.__version__},
+-                  fixed_conditions={"feature_names": FEATURE_NAMES, "feature_count": len(FEATURE_NAMES), "intensity": "Pillow.convert('L'), native resolution, no augmentation", "statistics": "mean/std(ddof0)/min/max/percentiles(linear)/normalized32bins[0,256)", "border": "outer5% width+height using ceil/min1; corner pixels once", "scaler": "StandardScaler fit only train769", "logreg": {"C": 1, "solver": "lbfgs", "random_state": 42, "max_iter": 2000, "tol": 1e-4, "class_weight": None, "default_penalty": "l2"}, "prediction_threshold": "decision_function>0 (probability>0.5); exact zero→class0, sklearn binary predict rule", "shuffle_seeds": list(range(42, 52)), "grouping": "64x64 Pillow BILINEAR uint8; direct squared Euclidean float64; RMSE<=5; connected components", "tuning": "none; no validation/test fitting or parameter selection", "cpu_threads": 1},
+-                  official_references=["https://scikit-learn.org/stable/common_pitfalls.html", "https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression.html"])
+-    save(output, report)
+-    print("원영상 무결성·통계 읽기 시작", flush=True)
+-    descriptors, whole, border = [], [], []
+-    actual_rows = []
+-    source_sha_hasher = hashlib.sha256()
+-    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
+-        path = Path(row["path"])
+-        raw = path.read_bytes()
+-        assert sha(raw) == row["byte_sha256"], "원영상 byte SHA 불일치"
+-        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as image:
+-            gray = image.convert("L")
+-            width, height = gray.size
+-            pixels = np.asarray(gray, dtype=np.uint8)
+-            pixel_sha = sha(f"L:{width}:{height}:".encode() + gray.tobytes())
+-            thumb = np.asarray(gray.resize((64, 64), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR), dtype=np.uint8)
+-        assert pixel_sha == row["pixel_sha256"] and (width, height) == (row["width"], row["height"]), "픽셀 SHA·크기 불일치"
+-        assert sha(thumb.tobytes()) == row["similarity_descriptor_sha256"], "유사 descriptor SHA 불일치"
+-        source_sha_hasher.update(row["relative_path"].encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + bytes.fromhex(sha(raw)))
+-        descriptors.append(thumb.reshape(-1).astype(np.float64))
+-        whole.append(statistics(pixels))

+-        actual_rows.append({"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "byte_sha256": sha(raw), "pixel_sha256": pixel_sha})
+-        if (index + 1) % 200 == 0 or index + 1 == len(rows):

+-    names = [r["relative_path"] for r in rows]
+-    assert len(set(names)) == len(names), "manifest 원본 상대경로 중복"
+-    name_to_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(names)}
+-    labels = np.array([r["label"] for r in rows], dtype=int)
+-    assert set(labels) == {0, 1}, "이진 라벨 이외 값"

+-def main():
+-    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

+-        self_check()
+-        return
+-    if not args.source_root:
+-        parser.error("--source-root 필요")
+-    output = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("데이터원인_독립감사_비공개.json")
+-    report = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="strict")) if output.exists() else {"schema_version": 1, "failures": []}
+-    try:
+-        execute(args, report, output)
+-    except Exception:
+-        error = traceback.format_exc()
+-        report["status"] = "실패"
+-        report["outcome"] = "FAIL"

+-                                                    "cwd": str(Path.cwd()), "exit_code": 1, "error": error, "source_modified": False,
+-                                                    "repair_used_local": report.get("repair_used_local", 0), "input_fix_used_local": report.get("input_fix_used_local", 0)})

+-

+-def reference_blur(array, sigma):
+-    # 기존 Torch FFT 구현을 호출하지 않는 독립 SciPy 식입니다.
+-    value = np.asarray(array, dtype=np.float64)
+-    height, width = value.shape[-2:]
+-    y = np.arange(height, dtype=np.float64) * np.pi / height
+-    x = np.arange(width, dtype=np.float64) * np.pi / width
+-    transfer = np.exp(-0.5 * float(sigma) ** 2 * (y[:, None] ** 2 + x[None, :] ** 2))
+-    return idctn(dctn(value, type=2, axes=(-2, -1), norm="ortho") * transfer,
+-                 type=2, axes=(-2, -1), norm="ortho")
+-

+-def math_checks(device="cpu"):
+-    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
+-    rows = []
+-    for height, width in [(17, 19), (256, 256)]:
+-        impulse = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=np.float32)
+-        impulse[height // 2, width // 2] = 1
+-        signals = [("constant", np.full((height, width), 2.5, np.float32), None),
+-                   ("impulse", impulse, None),
+-                   ("random", rng.normal(size=(height, width)).astype(np.float32), None)]
+-        for ky, kx in [(1, 0), (0, 1), (3, 4), (height // 2, 0)]:
+-            mode = (np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(height)[:, None] + 0.5) * ky / height)
+-                    * np.cos(np.pi * (np.arange(width)[None, :] + 0.5) * kx / width)).astype(np.float32)
+-            signals.append((f"cosine_{ky}_{kx}", mode, (ky, kx)))
+-        for name, signal, mode in signals:
+-            tensor = torch.tensor(signal[None, None], device=device)
+-            for sigma in SIGMAS:
+-                with torch.inference_mode():
+-                    actual = GaussianDCTBlur(sigma).to(device)(tensor).cpu().numpy()[0, 0].astype(np.float64)
+-                reference = reference_blur(signal, sigma)
+-                maximum_error = float(np.max(np.abs(actual - reference)))
+-                mean_error = abs(float(actual.mean() - signal.astype(np.float64).mean()))
+-                tolerance = 3e-5 * max(1.0, float(np.abs(signal).max()))
+-                if maximum_error > tolerance or mean_error > tolerance:
+-                    raise AssertionError(f"독립 DCT 대조 실패: {device}/{height}x{width}/{name}/{sigma}, {maximum_error}, {mean_error}")
+-                expected_gain = actual_gain = gain_error = None
+-                if mode is not None:
+-                    ky, kx = mode
+-                    expected_gain = math.exp(-0.5 * sigma ** 2 * math.pi ** 2 * ((ky / height) ** 2 + (kx / width) ** 2))
+-                    signal64 = signal.astype(np.float64)
+-                    actual_gain = float(np.sum(actual * signal64) / np.sum(signal64 ** 2))
+-                    gain_error = abs(actual_gain - expected_gain)
+-                    if gain_error > 3e-5:
+-                        raise AssertionError("코사인 주파수 이득이 사전 명세와 다릅니다.")
+-                rows.append({"device": device, "height": height, "width": width, "signal": name, "sigma": sigma,
+-                             "max_abs_error": maximum_error, "mean_abs_error": mean_error, "tolerance": tolerance,
+-                             "expected_gain": expected_gain, "actual_gain": actual_gain, "gain_abs_error": gain_error})
+-    if len(rows) != 70:
+-        raise AssertionError("수학 검사 조건 수가70이 아닙니다.")
+-    return {"n_cases": len(rows), "device": device, "max_abs_error": max(row["max_abs_error"] for row in rows),
+-            "max_mean_abs_error": max(row["mean_abs_error"] for row in rows), "cases": rows}
+-
+-
+-def metric_values(labels, logits, probabilities=None):
+-    y = np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64)
+-    z = np.asarray(logits, dtype=np.float64)
+-    p = expit(z) if probabilities is None else np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=np.float64)
+-    if not np.isfinite(z).all() or not np.isfinite(p).all() or y.shape != z.shape or y.shape != p.shape:
+-        raise ValueError("라벨·로짓·확률의 shape 또는 유한성이 잘못됐습니다.")
+-    predicted = (z >= 0).astype(np.int64)
+-    matrix = [[int(np.sum((y == a) & (predicted == b))) for b in (0, 1)] for a in (0, 1)]
+-    correct = int(np.sum(y == predicted))
+-    return {"correct": correct, "n_images": len(y), "accuracy": correct / len(y),
+-            "auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, z)), "confusion_matrix": matrix,
+-            "loss": float(np.logaddexp(0, -(2 * y - 1) * z).mean()),
+-            "logit_min": float(z.min()), "logit_max": float(z.max()),
+-            "threshold": 0.5, "logit_threshold": 0.0,
+-            "threshold_rounding_differences": int(np.sum(predicted != (p >= 0.5).astype(np.int64)))}
+-
+-
+-def prediction_rows(records, logits, probabilities):
+-    if len(records) != len(logits) or len(records) != len(probabilities):
+-        raise ValueError("예측 CSV의 원본 목록·값 수가 다릅니다.")
+-    return [{"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "label": row["label"], "logit": float(logit),
+-             "ng_probability": float(probability), "prediction": int(logit >= 0),
+-             "probability_prediction": int(probability >= 0.5)}
+-            for row, logit, probability in zip(records, logits, probabilities)]
+-
+-
+-def load_model(sigma, device):
+-    path = CHECKPOINTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_best.pt"
+-    baseline = read_json(BASELINE)
+-    known = {item["path"]: item["sha256"] for item in baseline["source_files"]}
+-    if str(path) not in known or digest(path) != known[str(path)]:
+-        raise ValueError("알려진 최초 SHA의 로컬 체크포인트만 읽을 수 있습니다.")
+-    saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+-    metrics = read_json(RESULTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_metrics.json")
+-    if saved["run_id"] != RUN_ID or saved["sigma"] != sigma or saved["epoch"] != metrics["best_epoch"]:
+-        raise ValueError("체크포인트의 실행·강도·선정 epoch가 기존 지표와 다릅니다.")
+-    model = SplitResNet50(sigma=sigma, pretrained=False).eval()
+-    model.load_state_dict(saved["model"], strict=True)
+-    return model.to(device), {"sigma": sigma, "epoch": saved["epoch"], "sha256": known[str(path)], "weights_only": True}
+-
+-
+-def infer(model, records, device):
+-    dataset = CTDataset(records, image_size=512, training=False)
+-    loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
+-    logits, probabilities = [], []
+-    with torch.inference_mode():
+-        for images, _ in loader:
+-            values = model(images.to(device).float()).double()
+-            logits.extend(values.cpu().tolist())
+-            probabilities.extend(values.sigmoid().cpu().tolist())
+-    return logits, probabilities
+-
+-
+-def compare_original(sigma, records, logits, probabilities):
+-    original = csv_rows(RESULTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_test_predictions_private.csv")
+-    if len(original) != len(records):
+-        raise AssertionError("원 CSV와 재추론 표본 수가 다릅니다.")
+-    if any(a["relative_path"] != b["relative_path"] or int(a["label"]) != b["label"] for a, b in zip(original, records)):
+-        raise AssertionError("원 CSV와 재추론 순서·라벨이 다릅니다.")
+-    old = np.asarray([float(row["ng_probability"]) for row in original])
+-    new = np.asarray(probabilities)
+-    prediction_mismatches = int(np.sum((old >= .5) != (np.asarray(logits) >= 0)))
+-    result = {"max_probability_abs_difference": float(np.max(np.abs(old - new))),
+-              "probabilities_within_prespecified_tolerance": bool(np.allclose(old, new, atol=2e-7, rtol=2e-5)),
+-              "prediction_mismatches": prediction_mismatches,
+-              "original_correct": int(np.sum((old >= .5) == np.asarray([row["label"] for row in records]))),
+-              "original_csv_has_logits": False}
+-    if prediction_mismatches or not result["probabilities_within_prespecified_tolerance"]:
+-        raise AssertionError("기존 CSV 확률·정답 재현이 사전 허용 범위를 벗어났습니다: " + json.dumps(result))
+-    return result
+-
+-
+-def cross_sigma(model, records, device, destination):
+-    # 각 모듈을 새로 만들어 강도 변경 때 기존 transfer 캐시를 재사용하지 않습니다.
+-    blurs = {sigma: GaussianDCTBlur(sigma).to(device) for sigma in SIGMAS}
+-    predictions = {sigma: {"logits": [], "probabilities": []} for sigma in SIGMAS}
+-    statistics = []
+-    dataset = CTDataset(records, image_size=512, training=False)
+-    loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
+-    offset = 0
+-    with torch.inference_mode():
+-        for images, _ in loader:
+-            images = images.to(device).float()
+-            features = model.edge((images - model.rgb_mean) / model.rgb_std)
+-            source64 = features.double()
+-            means = source64.mean(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True)
+-            base_ac = ((source64 - means) ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
+-            base_total = (source64 ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
+-            for sigma, blur in blurs.items():
+-                transmitted = blur(features)
+-                logits64 = model.cloud(transmitted).double()
+-                predictions[sigma]["logits"].extend(logits64.cpu().tolist())
+-                predictions[sigma]["probabilities"].extend(logits64.sigmoid().cpu().tolist())
+-                value64 = transmitted.double()
+-                new_means = value64.mean(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True)
+-                ac = ((value64 - new_means) ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
+-                mse = ((value64 - source64) ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3))
+-                arrays = {"base_ac_energy": base_ac, "ac_energy": ac,
+-                          "ac_retention_ratio": ac / base_ac,
+-                          "dc_energy": (new_means ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3)),
+-                          "total_energy": (value64 ** 2).mean(dim=(1, 2, 3)),
+-                          "relative_squared_change": mse / base_total,
+-                          "mse_from_unblurred": mse,
+-                          "max_channel_mean_abs_difference": (new_means - means).abs().amax(dim=(1, 2, 3))}
+-                arrays = {name: values.cpu().tolist() for name, values in arrays.items()}
+-                for index in range(len(images)):
+-                    row = records[offset + index]
+-                    statistics.append({"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "label": row["label"], "sigma": sigma,
+-                                       **{name: values[index] for name, values in arrays.items()}})
+-            offset += len(images)
+-            if offset == 8 or offset % 40 == 0 or offset == len(records):
+-                progress("cross_sigma", completed_images=offset, total_images=len(records))
+-    summary = {}
+-    for sigma in SIGMAS:
+-        selected = [row for row in statistics if row["sigma"] == sigma]
+-        summary[str(sigma)] = {key: float(np.mean([row[key] for row in selected])) for key in selected[0]
+-                               if key not in {"relative_path", "label", "sigma"}}
+-        summary[str(sigma)]["maximum_channel_mean_error"] = max(row["max_channel_mean_abs_difference"] for row in selected)
+-    save_csv(destination / "CT특징_공간통계_비공개.csv", statistics)
+-    return predictions, summary
+-
+-
+-def dc_experiment(model, splits, device, destination):
+-    descriptors, labels = {}, {}
+-    for name in ["train", "validation", "test"]:
+-        loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(CTDataset(splits[name], image_size=512, training=False),
+-                                             batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
+-        values, targets = [], []
+-        with torch.inference_mode():
+-            for images, target in loader:
+-                features = model.edge((images.to(device).float() - model.rgb_mean) / model.rgb_std)
+-                values.append(features.double().mean(dim=(-2, -1)).cpu().numpy())
+-                targets.extend(target.int().tolist())
+-        descriptors[name] = np.concatenate(values, axis=0)
+-        labels[name] = np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.int64)
+-        progress("dc_extraction", split=name, n_images=len(targets), n_features=64)
+-    scaler = StandardScaler()
+-    scaled_train = scaler.fit_transform(descriptors["train"])
+-    classifier = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42)
+-    # validation/test 정보는 fit·표준화 추정·설정 선택에 사용하지 않습니다.
+-    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as captured:
+-        warnings.simplefilter("always")
+-        classifier.fit(scaled_train, labels["train"])
+-    if captured or int(classifier.n_iter_.max()) >= 2000:
+-        diagnostic = {"n_iter": classifier.n_iter_.tolist(), "warnings": [str(item.message) for item in captured]}
+-        save_json(destination / "DC분류기_수렴진단_비공개.json", diagnostic)
+-        raise RuntimeError("DC 분류기의 수렴 경고 또는 반복 상한 도달: " + json.dumps(diagnostic, ensure_ascii=False))
+-    reports = {}
+-    for name in ["train", "validation", "test"]:
+-        transformed = scaler.transform(descriptors[name])
+-        logits = classifier.decision_function(transformed)
+-        probabilities = classifier.predict_proba(transformed)[:, 1]
+-        reports[name] = metric_values(labels[name], logits, probabilities)
+-        save_csv(destination / f"DC평균64_{name}_예측_비공개.csv",
+-                 prediction_rows(splits[name], logits, probabilities))
+-        save_csv(destination / f"DC평균64_{name}_특징_비공개.csv",
+-                 [{"relative_path": row["relative_path"], "label": row["label"],
+-                   **{f"channel_{channel}": float(value) for channel, value in enumerate(vector)}}
+-                  for row, vector in zip(splits[name], descriptors[name])])
+-    reports.update(n_features=64, fit_split="train", scaler_fit_split="train", n_fit=769,
+-                   parameters={"C": 1.0, "solver": "lbfgs", "max_iter": 2000, "tol": 1e-4, "seed": 42},
+-                   n_iter=classifier.n_iter_.tolist(), warnings=[str(item.message) for item in captured],
+-                   scaler_mean=scaler.mean_.tolist(), scaler_scale=scaler.scale_.tolist(),
+-                   coefficients=classifier.coef_.tolist(), intercept=classifier.intercept_.tolist())
+-    return reports
+-
+-
+-def experiment():
+-    baseline = check_baseline(originals=True)
+-    if COMPLETE.exists():
+-        raise FileExistsError("완료 결과는 덮어쓰지 않습니다. 검증 모드를 사용하세요.")
+-    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+-        raise RuntimeError("확인한 CUDA 장치를 사용할 수 없습니다. CPU로 자동 대체하지 않습니다.")
+-    seed_everything(42, 4)
+-    started = time.monotonic()
+-    attempt = WORK / ("추가실험_" + datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f"))
+-    attempt.mkdir()
+-    save_json(attempt / "실행시작_비공개.json", {"time_kst": now(), "argv": [sys.executable, *sys.orig_argv[1:]],
+-              "cwd": os.getcwd(), "session": SESSION, "task": TASK, "counters": counters(),
+-              "runner_sha256": digest(__file__), "baseline_sha256": digest(BASELINE)})
+-    import scipy
+-    import sklearn
+-    download_calls = []
+-    def deny_download(*args, **kwargs):
+-        download_calls.append({"args": repr(args), "kwargs": repr(kwargs)})
+-        raise RuntimeError("이 실험은 외부 가중치 다운로드를 허용하지 않습니다.")
+-    torch.hub.download_url_to_file = deny_download
+-    environment = {"python": sys.version, "torch": torch.__version__, "scipy": scipy.__version__, "sklearn": sklearn.__version__,
+-                   "cuda": torch.version.cuda, "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0), "CPU_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
+-                   "batch_size": 8, "forward_precision": "fp32", "probability_precision": "fp64", "seed": 42,
+-                   "deterministic": torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled(), "CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG": os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"),
+-                   "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")}
+-    progress("math_started")
+-    math_cpu = math_checks("cpu")
+-    math_cuda = math_checks("cuda")
+-    save_json(attempt / "독립_DCT_대조_비공개.json", {"cpu": math_cpu, "cuda": math_cuda})
+-    manifest = get_manifest()
+-    splits = manifest["splits"]
+-    device = torch.device("cuda")
+-    reproduction = {}
+-    timings = {}
+-    fixed = None
+-    for sigma in REPRO_SIGMAS:
+-        tick = time.monotonic()
+-        model, checkpoint = load_model(sigma, device)
+-        logits, probabilities = infer(model, splits["test"], device)
+-        metric = metric_values([row["label"] for row in splits["test"]], logits, probabilities)
+-        original_comparison = compare_original(sigma, splits["test"], logits, probabilities)
+-        saved = read_json(RESULTS / f"sigma_{sigma}_metrics.json")["test"]
+-        if metric["accuracy"] != saved["accuracy"] or metric["auc"] != saved["auc"]:
+-            raise AssertionError("원 지표와 추가 추론의 정확도/AUC가 다릅니다.")
+-        reproduction[str(sigma)] = {"checkpoint": checkpoint, "metrics": metric, "original_comparison": original_comparison,
+-                                    "loss_difference_from_saved": metric["loss"] - saved["loss"]}
+-        save_csv(attempt / f"재현_sigma{sigma}_test_예측_비공개.csv", prediction_rows(splits["test"], logits, probabilities))
+-        timings["reproduction_sigma" + str(sigma)] = time.monotonic() - tick
+-        progress("reproduction", sigma=sigma, correct=metric["correct"], n_images=164,
+-                 max_probability_difference=original_comparison["max_probability_abs_difference"], seconds=timings["reproduction_sigma" + str(sigma)])
+-        if sigma == 0:
+-            fixed = model
+-        else:
+-            del model
+-            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+-    tick = time.monotonic()
+-    cross_predictions, feature_statistics = cross_sigma(fixed, splits["test"], device, attempt)
+-    cross = {}
+-    for sigma in SIGMAS:
+-        values = cross_predictions[sigma]
+-        cross[str(sigma)] = metric_values([row["label"] for row in splits["test"]], values["logits"], values["probabilities"])
+-        save_csv(attempt / f"고정sigma0_입력블러{sigma}_test_예측_비공개.csv",
+-                 prediction_rows(splits["test"], values["logits"], values["probabilities"]))
+-    timings["fixed_model_cross_sigma"] = time.monotonic() - tick
+-    # 분해 정방향이 원모델 정방향과 같은지 σ0 결과를 다시 대조합니다.
+-    zero_rows = csv_rows(attempt / "재현_sigma0_test_예측_비공개.csv")
+-    if not np.array_equal(np.asarray([float(row["logit"]) for row in zero_rows]), np.asarray(cross_predictions[0]["logits"])):
+-        raise AssertionError("고정 모델의 σ0 분해 정방향이 재현 정방향과 다릅니다.")
+-    tick = time.monotonic()
+-    dc = dc_experiment(fixed, splits, device, attempt)
+-    timings["dc_experiment"] = time.monotonic() - tick
+-    check_baseline(originals=True)
+-    report = {"schema_version": 1, "completed_at": now(), "session": SESSION, "task": TASK, "run_id": RUN_ID,
+-              "runner_sha256": digest(__file__), "baseline_sha256": digest(BASELINE), "environment": environment,
+-              "reproduction": reproduction, "fixed_sigma0_cross_sigma": cross, "feature_statistics": feature_statistics,
+-              "dc_only": dc, "math": {"cpu_cases": math_cpu["n_cases"], "cuda_cases": math_cuda["n_cases"],
+-                                        "cpu_max_abs_error": math_cpu["max_abs_error"], "cuda_max_abs_error": math_cuda["max_abs_error"]},
+-              "download_calls": len(download_calls), "timings_seconds": timings, "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
+-              "counters_at_run": counters(), "source_file_count": len(baseline["source_files"]), "original_file_count": len(baseline["original_files"]),
+-              "limitations": ["같은 기존 시험셋의 재사용 탐색적 진단; 결과를 본 튜닝 없음", "환자 ID 없어 환자 독립·임상·프라이버시 달성 미검증",
+-                              "DC 단서의 예측력은 원모델의 유일한 인과 사용 증명이 아님", "클래스당5000은 온라인 반복 표본"]}
+-    save_json(attempt / "실측결과_비공개.json", report)
+-    products = [{"relative_path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "sha256": digest(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size}
+-                for path in sorted(attempt.iterdir()) if path.is_file()]
+-    save_json(COMPLETE, {"completed_at": now(), "session": SESSION, "task": TASK, "run_id": RUN_ID,
+-                        "baseline_sha256": digest(BASELINE), "runner_sha256": digest(__file__),
+-                        "report": (attempt / "실측결과_비공개.json").relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "products": products})
+-    progress("experiment_complete", elapsed_seconds=report["elapsed_seconds"], products=len(products), download_calls=len(download_calls))
+-
+-
+-def verify_results():
+-    tick = time.monotonic()
+-    baseline = check_baseline(originals=True)
+-    complete = read_json(COMPLETE)
+-    if complete["session"] != SESSION or complete["task"] != TASK or complete["run_id"] != RUN_ID:
+-        raise AssertionError("완료 결과의 session/task/run이 다릅니다.")
+-    if complete["runner_sha256"] != digest(__file__) or complete["baseline_sha256"] != digest(BASELINE):
+-        raise AssertionError("완료 결과의 최종 소스 또는 최초 기준 SHA가 다릅니다.")
+-    for item in complete["products"]:
+-        path = (ROOT / item["relative_path"]).resolve()
+-        if not path.is_relative_to(WORK.resolve()) or digest(path) != item["sha256"] or path.stat().st_size != item["bytes"]:
+-            raise AssertionError("완료 산출물의 경계·SHA·크기가 다릅니다.")
+-    report = read_json(ROOT / complete["report"])
+-    attempt = (ROOT / complete["report"]).parent
+-    if report["download_calls"] != 0 or report["runner_sha256"] != digest(__file__) or report["baseline_sha256"] != digest(BASELINE):
+-        raise AssertionError("다운로드0·최종 소스·초기 기준 조건이 다릅니다.")
+-    manifest = get_manifest()
+-    checked = 0
+-    for prefix, sigmas, key in [("재현_sigma", REPRO_SIGMAS, "reproduction"), ("고정sigma0_입력블러", SIGMAS, "fixed_sigma0_cross_sigma")]:
+-        for sigma in sigmas:
+-            rows = csv_rows(attempt / f"{prefix}{sigma}_test_예측_비공개.csv")
+-            if len(rows) != 164 or any(row["relative_path"] != source["relative_path"] or int(row["label"]) != source["label"]
+-                                       for row, source in zip(rows, manifest["splits"]["test"])):
+-                raise AssertionError("시험 CSV 행수·순서·라벨이 다릅니다.")
+-            metrics = metric_values([int(row["label"]) for row in rows], [float(row["logit"]) for row in rows], [float(row["ng_probability"]) for row in rows])
+-            expected = report[key][str(sigma)]["metrics"] if key == "reproduction" else report[key][str(sigma)]
+-            if metrics != expected:
+-                raise AssertionError("CSV 재계산 지표와 저장 JSON이 다릅니다.")
+-            if key == "reproduction":
+-                compare_original(sigma, manifest["splits"]["test"], [float(row["logit"]) for row in rows], [float(row["ng_probability"]) for row in rows])
+-            checked += len(rows)
+-    for name, size in SIZES.items():
+-        rows = csv_rows(attempt / f"DC평균64_{name}_예측_비공개.csv")
+-        features = csv_rows(attempt / f"DC평균64_{name}_특징_비공개.csv")
+-        if len(rows) != size or len(features) != size:
+-            raise AssertionError("DC 예측 또는 특징 행수가 다릅니다.")
+-        if any(row["relative_path"] != original["relative_path"] or int(row["label"]) != original["label"] for row, original in zip(rows, manifest["splits"][name])):
+-            raise AssertionError("DC 예측 순서·라벨이 원분할과 다릅니다.")
+-        if any(len(row) != 66 for row in features):
+-            raise AssertionError("DC 특징이64개가 아닙니다.")
+-        metrics = metric_values([int(row["label"]) for row in rows], [float(row["logit"]) for row in rows], [float(row["ng_probability"]) for row in rows])

++  $('message').textContent=interrupted?'학습과 모형의 움직임을 멈추고 마지막 기록을 표시합니다.':s.status==='failed'?'오류를 확인한 뒤 다시 시작합니다. 실행 기록은 보존되어 있습니다.':s.training_status!=='completed'?'블러 0에서 새 모델을 한 번만 100회 학습합니다. 다른 강도는 모두 평가 대기입니다.':'검증 손실이 가장 낮았던 모델 한 개를 고정했습니다. 블러 강도만 바꾸며 추가 학습 없이 평가합니다.';
++  $('badge').textContent=interrupted?'중단':states[s.status] || '상태 확인 중';
++  let warning=interrupted ? '학습이 중단되었습니다. 마지막 기록을 표시하며 모형의 움직임도 멈췄습니다.' : failed ? '실험이 오류로 중단되었습니다. 작업 기록을 확인해 주세요.' : dead ? '학습 프로세스가 종료되었습니다. 마지막 기록을 표시합니다.' : meta.read_error ? meta.read_error : meta.stale ? '60초 이상 새 기록이 없어요. 관찰용 알림이며 학습을 멈추는 기준은 아닙니다.' : '';
++  $('alert').textContent=warning;$('alert').className=warning?`alert visible${failed||dead?' failed':''}`:'alert';
++  $('sigmaLabel').textContent=s.training_status==='completed'?`학습 완료 · 모델 고정 · ${number(s.evaluation_current_sigma)?'현재 평가 σ '+s.evaluation_current_sigma:'평가 준비'}`:'한 번의 학습 · 블러 σ 0 · 평가 10조건 대기';
++  $('fixedModelStatus').textContent=s.training_status==='completed'&&s.checkpoint_sha256?'100회 학습 완료 · 최저 검증 손실 모델 고정':'블러 0 학습 완료 후 모델 한 개를 고정합니다';
++  $('fixedModelHash').textContent=s.training_status==='completed'&&s.checkpoint_sha256?s.checkpoint_sha256:'고정 모델 해시 대기';
++  const policy=s.training_policy || {};
++  const maximum=number(policy.max_epochs)?policy.max_epochs:s.epochs;
++  $('epoch').textContent=`${measured(s.epoch)}회 / ${policy.early_stopping_enabled===false?'목표':'최대'} ${measured(maximum)}회`;
++  $('learningRate').textContent=rawNumber(s.learning_rate);
++  $('earlyStopping').textContent=policy.early_stopping_enabled===false?'조기 종료 끔 · 블러 0에서 한 번 100회':'실제 학습 정책 확인 대기';
++  $('trainingPolicyNote').textContent='① 블러 0에서 한 번 100회 학습 → ② 검증 손실 최저 모델 한 개 고정 → ③ 같은 모델로 σ 0·1·2·4·8·16·32·64·128·256 평가. 강도별 재학습은 하지 않습니다.';
++  $('bestEpoch').textContent=number(s.best_epoch)?`${s.best_epoch}회`:'미측정';
++  $('optimizerSteps').textContent=measured(s.optimizer_steps);
++  $('batch').textContent=`배치 ${shown(s.batch)} / ${shown(s.batches)}`;

++  $('process').textContent=interrupted?'학습 중단':meta.process_alive===true?'학습 프로세스 실행 중':meta.process_alive===false?'학습 프로세스 종료':'학습 프로세스 확인 대기';
++  $('seen').textContent=`이번 회차 OK ${shown(s.seen_per_class?.OK)} / NG ${shown(s.seen_per_class?.NG)}`;

++  const stampText=Number.isNaN(stamp.getTime())?'갱신 시각 미확인':stamp.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',hour12:false});
++  $('updated').textContent=`최근 갱신 ${stampText}`;
++  $('freshness').textContent=`한국 시각 ${stampText} · ${number(meta.age_seconds)?Math.floor(meta.age_seconds)+'초 전 관측':'관측 대기'}`;

++  renderQueue(s);
++  const changedRun=selectionRun!==s.run_id;

++  }
++  if(selectedSigma===null){const first=(s.sigma_queue||[]).find(x=>x.status==='completed'&&sigmaChoices.includes(x.sigma));selectedSigma=first?.sigma??(sigmaChoices.includes(s.sigma)?s.sigma:0);}

++  pipeline?.setSelectedSigma(selectedSigma,selectionRun);renderQueue(s);loadSelectedResult();
++  const splits=s.dataset?.splits;
++  $('splits').replaceChildren();
++  if(splits){for(const [key,label] of [['train','학습'],['validation','검증'],['test','시험']]){const row=document.createElement('tr');for(const value of [label,shown(splits[key]?.OK),shown(splits[key]?.NG),shown(splits[key]?.total)]){const cell=document.createElement('td');cell.textContent=value;row.append(cell);}$('splits').append(row);}}
++  else {const row=document.createElement('tr');const cell=document.createElement('td');cell.colSpan=4;cell.textContent='분할 결과 대기 · 미측정';row.append(cell);$('splits').append(row);}
++  $('record').textContent=`${stampText} · ${states[s.status] || '기록 대기'} · ${stages[s.stage] || '상태 확인 중'}`;
++  $('error').textContent=s.error ? `오류 유형: ${typeof s.error==='object' ? s.error.error_type || '실행 오류' : '실행 오류'} · 상세 원문은 이 PC의 실행 기록에 보관됩니다.` : '';
++  if($('quickSigma'))$('quickSigma').textContent=number(s.sigma)?`σ ${s.sigma}`:'—';
++  if($('quickEpoch'))$('quickEpoch').textContent=number(s.epoch)?`${s.epoch} / ${shown(s.epochs)}`:'—';
++  if($('originalCount'))$('originalCount').textContent=number(s.dataset?.original_total)?s.dataset.original_total.toLocaleString('ko-KR'):'미확인';
++}
++async function refresh() {
++  if(refreshing)return;refreshing=true;
++  try {const response=await fetch('/api/status',{cache:'no-store'});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(String(response.status));render(await response.json());}
++  catch { $('alert').className='alert visible failed';$('alert').textContent='상태 서버에 연결할 수 없습니다. 마지막 관측값을 표시합니다. 세션 URL과 서버 실행 상태를 확인해 주세요.';pipeline?.setStatus(0,'failed',false); }
++  finally {refreshing=false;}
++}
++$('scene').addEventListener('ct-sigma-select',event=>{if(event.detail?.run_id===selectionRun)selectSigma(event.detail.sigma);});
++$('refresh').addEventListener('click',refresh);
++window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(latest)drawChart({sigma:selectedSigma,history:selectedResult?.history||[],evaluation_history:selectedResult?.evaluation_history||[]});});
++for(const link of document.querySelectorAll('nav a'))link.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelector('nav .active')?.classList.remove('active');link.classList.add('active');});
++refresh();setInterval(refresh,3000);

+## web/theme.js
+
+이전 0 B / SHA-256 `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`. 이후 700 B / SHA-256 `a23aaaac34bf5e0b64f1ccc956cb2dc588029e2448e2d469d98b4f259717d6f2`.
+
+````diff
+--- 이전/web/theme.js
++++ 이후/web/theme.js
+@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
++// 저장된 사용자 선택이 없으면 밝은 화면으로 시작합니다.
++(() => {
++  let selected = null;
++  try { selected = localStorage.getItem('ct-lab-theme'); } catch {}
++  if (!['light','dark'].includes(selected)) selected = null;
++  function apply() {
++    const theme = selected || 'light';
++    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
++    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ct-theme-change', {detail:theme}));
++  }
++  window.ctTheme = {
++    current: () => document.documentElement.dataset.theme,
++    toggle: () => {selected = window.ctTheme.current()==='dark'?'light':'dark';try{localStorage.setItem('ct-lab-theme',selected);}catch{}apply();}
++  };
++  apply();
++})();
+````

++/**

++ *
++ * Code Example:
++ * ```js
++ * class Car extends EventDispatcher {
++ * 	start() {
++ *		this.dispatchEvent( { type: 'start', message: 'vroom vroom!' } );
++ *	}
++ *};
++ *
++ * // Using events with the custom object
++ * const car = new Car();
++ * car.addEventListener( 'start', function ( event ) {
++ * 	alert( event.message );
++ * } );
++ *
++ * car.start();
++ * ```

++	 *
++	 * @param {string} type - The type of event to listen to.
++	 * @param {Function} listener - The function that gets called when the event is fired.
++	 */
++	addEventListener( type, listener ) {
++
++		if ( this._listeners === undefined ) this._listeners = {};
++
++		const listeners = this._listeners;
++
++		if ( listeners[ type ] === undefined ) {
++
++			listeners[ type ] = [];
++
++		}
++
++		if ( listeners[ type ].indexOf( listener ) === -1 ) {
++
++			listeners[ type ].push( listener );
++
++		}
++
++	}
++
++	/**
++	 * Returns `true` if the given event listener has been added to the given event type.
++	 *
++	 * @param {string} type - The type of event.
++	 * @param {Function} listener - The listener to check.
++	 * @return {boolean} Whether the given event listener has been added to the given event type.
++	 */
++	hasEventListener( type, listener ) {

++		const listeners = this._listeners;

++		if ( listeners === undefined ) return false;

++	}

++	/**

++	 *
++	 * @param {string} type - The type of event.
++	 * @param {Function} listener - The listener to remove.
++	 */
++	removeEventListener( type, listener ) {

++		const listeners = this._listeners;
++
++		if ( listeners === undefined ) return;

++		const listenerArray = listeners[ type ];
++
++		if ( listenerArray !== undefined ) {
++
++			const index = listenerArray.indexOf( listener );
++
++			if ( index !== -1 ) {

++				listenerArray.splice( index, 1 );
++
++			}
++
++		}
++
++	}
++
++	/**
++	 * Dispatches an event object.
++	 *
++	 * @param {Object} event - The event that gets fired.
++	 */
++	dispatchEvent( event ) {

++		if ( listeners === undefined ) return;

++			for ( let i = 0, l = array.length; i < l; i ++ ) {

++				array[ i ].call( this, event );

++			}
++
++			event.target = null;
++
++		}
++
++	}

++			this._y = - qb._y;

++	/**
++	 * Sets the rotation component (the upper left 3x3 matrix) of this matrix to
++	 * the rotation specified by the given Euler angles. The rest of
++	 * the matrix is set to the identity. Depending on the {@link Euler#order},
++	 * there are six possible outcomes. See [this page]{@link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles#Rotation_matrix}
++	 * for a complete list.
++	 *
++	 * @param {Euler} euler - The Euler angles.
++	 * @return {Matrix4} A reference to this matrix.

++	makeRotationFromEuler( euler ) {
++
++		const te = this.elements;
++
++		const x = euler.x, y = euler.y, z = euler.z;
++		const a = Math.cos( x ), b = Math.sin( x );
++		const c = Math.cos( y ), d = Math.sin( y );
++		const e = Math.cos( z ), f = Math.sin( z );
++
++		if ( euler.order === 'XYZ' ) {
++
++			const ae = a * e, af = a * f, be = b * e, bf = b * f;
++
++			te[ 0 ] = c * e;
++			te[ 4 ] = - c * f;
++			te[ 8 ] = d;
++
++			te[ 1 ] = af + be * d;
++			te[ 5 ] = ae - bf * d;
++			te[ 9 ] = - b * c;
++
++			te[ 2 ] = bf - ae * d;
++			te[ 6 ] = be + af * d;
++			te[ 10 ] = a * c;
++
++		} else if ( euler.order === 'YXZ' ) {
++
++			const ce = c * e, cf = c * f, de = d * e, df = d * f;
++
++			te[ 0 ] = ce + df * b;
++			te[ 4 ] = de * b - cf;
++			te[ 8 ] = a * d;
++
++			te[ 1 ] = a * f;
++			te[ 5 ] = a * e;
++			te[ 9 ] = - b;
++
++			te[ 2 ] = cf * b - de;
++			te[ 6 ] = df + ce * b;
++			te[ 10 ] = a * c;
++
++		} else if ( euler.order === 'ZXY' ) {
++
++			const ce = c * e, cf = c * f, de = d * e, df = d * f;
++
++			te[ 0 ] = ce - df * b;
++			te[ 4 ] = - a * f;
++			te[ 8 ] = de + cf * b;
++
++			te[ 1 ] = cf + de * b;
++			te[ 5 ] = a * e;
++			te[ 9 ] = df - ce * b;
++
++			te[ 2 ] = - a * d;
++			te[ 6 ] = b;
++			te[ 10 ] = a * c;
++
++		} else if ( euler.order === 'ZYX' ) {
++
++			const ae = a * e, af = a * f, be = b * e, bf = b * f;
++
++			te[ 0 ] = c * e;
++			te[ 4 ] = be * d - af;
++			te[ 8 ] = ae * d + bf;
++
++			te[ 1 ] = c * f;
++			te[ 5 ] = bf * d + ae;
++			te[ 9 ] = af * d - be;
++
++			te[ 2 ] = - d;
++			te[ 6 ] = b * c;
++			te[ 10 ] = a * c;
++
++		} else if ( euler.order === 'YZX' ) {
++
++			const ac = a * c, ad = a * d, bc = b * c, bd = b * d;
++
++			te[ 0 ] = c * e;
++			te[ 4 ] = bd - ac * f;
++			te[ 8 ] = bc * f + ad;
++
++			te[ 1 ] = f;
++			te[ 5 ] = a * e;
++			te[ 9 ] = - b * e;
++
++			te[ 2 ] = - d * e;
++			te[ 6 ] = ad * f + bc;
++			te[ 10 ] = ac - bd * f;
++
++		} else if ( euler.order === 'XZY' ) {
++
++			const ac = a * c, ad = a * d, bc = b * c, bd = b * d;

++			te[ 0 ] = c * e;
++			te[ 4 ] = - f;
++			te[ 8 ] = d * e;
++
++			te[ 1 ] = ac * f + bd;
++			te[ 5 ] = a * e;
++			te[ 9 ] = ad * f - bc;
++
++			te[ 2 ] = bc * f - ad;
++			te[ 6 ] = b * e;
++			te[ 10 ] = bd * f + ac;

++		}

++		// bottom row
++		te[ 3 ] = 0;
++		te[ 7 ] = 0;
++		te[ 11 ] = 0;
++
++		// last column
++		te[ 12 ] = 0;
++		te[ 13 ] = 0;
++		te[ 14 ] = 0;
++		te[ 15 ] = 1;
++
++		return this;
++
++	}

++	/**
++	 * Sets the rotation component of this matrix to the rotation specified by

++	 * @param {Quaternion} q - The Quaternion.
++	 * @return {Matrix4} A reference to this matrix.
++	 */
++	makeRotationFromQuaternion( q ) {
++
++		return this.compose( _zero, q, _one );

++	}

++	/**

++	 * `target`, and oriented by the up-direction.

++	 * @param {Vector3} up - The up vector.
++	 * @return {Matrix4} A reference to this matrix.
++	 */
++	lookAt( eye, target, up ) {
++
++		const te = this.elements;
++
++		_z.subVectors( eye, target );
++
++		if ( _z.lengthSq() === 0 ) {
++
++			// eye and target are in the same position
++
++			_z.z = 1;
++
++		}
++
++		_z.normalize();
++		_x.crossVectors( up, _z );

++		if ( _x.lengthSq() === 0 ) {

++			// up and z are parallel

++				_z.x += 0.0001;
++
++			} else {
++
++				_z.z += 0.0001;

++			}
++
++			_z.normalize();
++			_x.crossVectors( up, _z );

++		}

++		te[ 1 ] = _x.y; te[ 5 ] = _y.y; te[ 9 ] = _z.y;
++		te[ 2 ] = _x.z; te[ 6 ] = _y.z; te[ 10 ] = _z.z;

++		return this;

++	/**

++	/**

++	/**

++	multiplyMatrices( a, b ) {

++		const ae = a.elements;
++		const be = b.elements;
++		const te = this.elements;
++
++		const a11 = ae[ 0 ], a12 = ae[ 4 ], a13 = ae[ 8 ], a14 = ae[ 12 ];
++		const a21 = ae[ 1 ], a22 = ae[ 5 ], a23 = ae[ 9 ], a24 = ae[ 13 ];

++		const b11 = be[ 0 ], b12 = be[ 4 ], b13 = be[ 8 ], b14 = be[ 12 ];
++		const b21 = be[ 1 ], b22 = be[ 5 ], b23 = be[ 9 ], b24 = be[ 13 ];
++		const b31 = be[ 2 ], b32 = be[ 6 ], b33 = be[ 10 ], b34 = be[ 14 ];
++		const b41 = be[ 3 ], b42 = be[ 7 ], b43 = be[ 11 ], b44 = be[ 15 ];

++		te[ 1 ] = a21 * b11 + a22 * b21 + a23 * b31 + a24 * b41;
++		te[ 5 ] = a21 * b12 + a22 * b22 + a23 * b32 + a24 * b42;
++		te[ 9 ] = a21 * b13 + a22 * b23 + a23 * b33 + a24 * b43;
++		te[ 13 ] = a21 * b14 + a22 * b24 + a23 * b34 + a24 * b44;

++		te[ 14 ] = a31 * b14 + a32 * b24 + a33 * b34 + a34 * b44;

++		te[ 7 ] = a41 * b12 + a42 * b22 + a43 * b32 + a44 * b42;
++		te[ 11 ] = a41 * b13 + a42 * b23 + a43 * b33 + a44 * b43;
++		te[ 15 ] = a41 * b14 + a42 * b24 + a43 * b34 + a44 * b44;

++	/**

++	/**

++		const n31 = te[ 2 ], n32 = te[ 6 ], n33 = te[ 10 ], n34 = te[ 14 ];

++	/**

++
++			n11 = te[ 0 ], n21 = te[ 1 ], n31 = te[ 2 ], n41 = te[ 3 ],
++			n12 = te[ 4 ], n22 = te[ 5 ], n32 = te[ 6 ], n42 = te[ 7 ],
++			n13 = te[ 8 ], n23 = te[ 9 ], n33 = te[ 10 ], n43 = te[ 11 ],
++			n14 = te[ 12 ], n24 = te[ 13 ], n34 = te[ 14 ], n44 = te[ 15 ],

++	/**

++	/**

++	constructor( size = 1, options = {} ) {
++
++		super( size, size, options );
++
++		/**
++		 * This flag can be used for type testing.
++		 *
++		 * @type {boolean}
++		 * @readonly
++		 * @default true
++		 */
++		this.isWebGLCubeRenderTarget = true;
++
++		const image = { width: size, height: size, depth: 1 };
++		const images = [ image, image, image, image, image, image ];

++		 *
++		 * @type {DataArrayTexture}

++		this._setTextureOptions( options );

++		// By convention -- likely based on the RenderMan spec from the 1990's -- cube maps are specified by WebGL (and three.js)
++		// in a coordinate system in which positive-x is to the right when looking up the positive-z axis -- in other words,
++		// in a left-handed coordinate system. By continuing this convention, preexisting cube maps continued to render correctly.
++
++		// three.js uses a right-handed coordinate system. So environment maps used in three.js appear to have px and nx swapped
++		// and the flag isRenderTargetTexture controls this conversion. The flip is not required when using WebGLCubeRenderTarget.texture

++	 * @return {WebGLCubeRenderTarget} A reference to this cube render target.

++		this.texture.colorSpace = texture.colorSpace;

++		this.texture.generateMipmaps = texture.generateMipmaps;
++		this.texture.minFilter = texture.minFilter;
++		this.texture.magFilter = texture.magFilter;

++
++			uniforms: {
++				tEquirect: { value: null },
++			},
++
++			vertexShader: /* glsl */`
++
++				varying vec3 vWorldDirection;
++
++				vec3 transformDirection( in vec3 dir, in mat4 matrix ) {
++
++					return normalize( ( matrix * vec4( dir, 0.0 ) ).xyz );
++
++				}
++
++				void main() {
++
++					vWorldDirection = transformDirection( position, modelMatrix );
++
++					#include <begin_vertex>
++					#include <project_vertex>
++
++				}
++			`,
++
++			fragmentShader: /* glsl */`
++
++				uniform sampler2D tEquirect;
++
++				varying vec3 vWorldDirection;
++
++				#include <common>
++
++				void main() {
++
++					vec3 direction = normalize( vWorldDirection );
++
++					vec2 sampleUV = equirectUv( direction );

++				}

++		};

++		const geometry = new BoxGeometry( 5, 5, 5 );
++
++		const material = new ShaderMaterial( {
++
++			name: 'CubemapFromEquirect',
++
++			uniforms: cloneUniforms( shader.uniforms ),
++			vertexShader: shader.vertexShader,
++			fragmentShader: shader.fragmentShader,
++			side: BackSide,
++			blending: NoBlending

++		} );

++		material.uniforms.tEquirect.value = texture;

++		const mesh = new Mesh( geometry, material );

++		camera.update( renderer, mesh );

++		texture.minFilter = currentMinFilter;

++		mesh.geometry.dispose();
++		mesh.material.dispose();
++
++		return this;
++
++	}
++
++	/**
++	 * Clears this cube render target.
++	 *
++	 * @param {WebGLRenderer} renderer - The renderer.
++	 * @param {boolean} [color=true] - Whether the color buffer should be cleared or not.
++	 * @param {boolean} [depth=true] - Whether the depth buffer should be cleared or not.
++	 * @param {boolean} [stencil=true] - Whether the stencil buffer should be cleared or not.
++	 */

++

++			renderer.setRenderTarget( this, i );
++
++			renderer.clear( color, depth, stencil );
++
++		}
++
++		renderer.setRenderTarget( currentRenderTarget );
++
++	}
++
++}

++		/**

++		/**

++	/**

++/**
++ * A geometry class for representing a capsule.
++ *
++ * ```js
++ * const geometry = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry( 1, 1, 4, 8, 1 );
++ * const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial( { color: 0x00ff00 } );
++ * const capsule = new THREE.Mesh( geometry, material );
++ * scene.add( capsule );
++ * ```
++ *
++ * @augments BufferGeometry
++ */
++class CapsuleGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
++
++	/**
++	 * Constructs a new capsule geometry.
++	 *
++	 * @param {number} [radius=1] - Radius of the capsule.
++	 * @param {number} [height=1] - Height of the middle section.
++	 * @param {number} [capSegments=4] - Number of curve segments used to build each cap.
++	 * @param {number} [radialSegments=8] - Number of segmented faces around the circumference of the capsule. Must be an integer >= 3.
++	 * @param {number} [heightSegments=1] - Number of rows of faces along the height of the middle section. Must be an integer >= 1.
++	 */
++	constructor( radius = 1, height = 1, capSegments = 4, radialSegments = 8, heightSegments = 1 ) {
++
++		super();
++
++		this.type = 'CapsuleGeometry';
++
++		/**
++		 * Holds the constructor parameters that have been
++		 * used to generate the geometry. Any modification
++		 * after instantiation does not change the geometry.
++		 *
++		 * @type {Object}
++		 */
++		this.parameters = {
++			radius: radius,
++			height: height,
++			capSegments: capSegments,
++			radialSegments: radialSegments,
++			heightSegments: heightSegments,
++		};
++
++		height = Math.max( 0, height );
++		capSegments = Math.max( 1, Math.floor( capSegments ) );
++		radialSegments = Math.max( 3, Math.floor( radialSegments ) );
++		heightSegments = Math.max( 1, Math.floor( heightSegments ) );
++
++		// buffers
++
++		const indices = [];
++		const vertices = [];
++		const normals = [];
++		const uvs = [];
++
++		// helper variables
++
++		const halfHeight = height / 2;
++		const capArcLength = ( Math.PI / 2 ) * radius;
++		const cylinderPartLength = height;
++		const totalArcLength = 2 * capArcLength + cylinderPartLength;
++
++		const numVerticalSegments = capSegments * 2 + heightSegments;
++		const verticesPerRow = radialSegments + 1;
++
++		const normal = new Vector3();
++		const vertex = new Vector3();
++
++		// generate vertices, normals, and uvs
++
++		for ( let iy = 0; iy <= numVerticalSegments; iy ++ ) {
++
++			let currentArcLength = 0;
++			let profileY = 0;
++			let profileRadius = 0;
++			let normalYComponent = 0;
++
++			if ( iy <= capSegments ) {
++
++				// bottom cap
++				const segmentProgress = iy / capSegments;
++				const angle = ( segmentProgress * Math.PI ) / 2;
++				profileY = - halfHeight - radius * Math.cos( angle );
++				profileRadius = radius * Math.sin( angle );
++				normalYComponent = - radius * Math.cos( angle );
++				currentArcLength = segmentProgress * capArcLength;
++
++			} else if ( iy <= capSegments + heightSegments ) {
++
++				// middle section
++				const segmentProgress = ( iy - capSegments ) / heightSegments;
++				profileY = - halfHeight + segmentProgress * height;
++				profileRadius = radius;
++				normalYComponent = 0;
++				currentArcLength = capArcLength + segmentProgress * cylinderPartLength;
++
++			} else {
++
++				// top cap
++				const segmentProgress =
++					( iy - capSegments - heightSegments ) / capSegments;
++				const angle = ( segmentProgress * Math.PI ) / 2;
++				profileY = halfHeight + radius * Math.sin( angle );
++				profileRadius = radius * Math.cos( angle );
++				normalYComponent = radius * Math.sin( angle );
++				currentArcLength =
++					capArcLength + cylinderPartLength + segmentProgress * capArcLength;
++
++			}
++
++			const v = Math.max( 0, Math.min( 1, currentArcLength / totalArcLength ) );
++
++
++			// special case for the poles
++
++			let uOffset = 0;
++
++			if ( iy === 0 ) {
++
++				uOffset = 0.5 / radialSegments;
++
++			} else if ( iy === numVerticalSegments ) {
++
++				uOffset = -0.5 / radialSegments;
++
++			}
++
++			for ( let ix = 0; ix <= radialSegments; ix ++ ) {
++
++				const u = ix / radialSegments;
++				const theta = u * Math.PI * 2;
++
++				const sinTheta = Math.sin( theta );
++				const cosTheta = Math.cos( theta );
++
++				// vertex
++
++				vertex.x = - profileRadius * cosTheta;
++				vertex.y = profileY;
++				vertex.z = profileRadius * sinTheta;
++				vertices.push( vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z );
++
++				// normal
++
++				normal.set(
++					- profileRadius * cosTheta,
++					normalYComponent,
++					profileRadius * sinTheta
++				);
++				normal.normalize();
++				normals.push( normal.x, normal.y, normal.z );
++
++				// uv
++
++				uvs.push( u + uOffset, v );
++
++			}
++
++			if ( iy > 0 ) {
++
++				const prevIndexRow = ( iy - 1 ) * verticesPerRow;
++				for ( let ix = 0; ix < radialSegments; ix ++ ) {
++
++					const i1 = prevIndexRow + ix;
++					const i2 = prevIndexRow + ix + 1;
++					const i3 = iy * verticesPerRow + ix;
++					const i4 = iy * verticesPerRow + ix + 1;
++
++					indices.push( i1, i2, i3 );
++					indices.push( i2, i4, i3 );
++
++				}
++
++			}
++
++		}
++
++		// build geometry
++
++		this.setIndex( indices );
++		this.setAttribute( 'position', new Float32BufferAttribute( vertices, 3 ) );
++		this.setAttribute( 'normal', new Float32BufferAttribute( normals, 3 ) );
++		this.setAttribute( 'uv', new Float32BufferAttribute( uvs, 2 ) );
++
++	}
++
++	copy( source ) {
++
++		super.copy( source );
++
++		this.parameters = Object.assign( {}, source.parameters );
++
++		return this;
++
++	}
++
++	/**
++	 * Factory method for creating an instance of this class from the given
++	 * JSON object.
++	 *
++	 * @param {Object} data - A JSON object representing the serialized geometry.
++	 * @return {CapsuleGeometry} A new instance.
++	 */
++	static fromJSON( data ) {
++
++		return new CapsuleGeometry( data.radius, data.height, data.capSegments, data.radialSegments, data.heightSegments );
++
++	}
++
++}

++/**
++ * A simple shape of Euclidean geometry. It is constructed from a
++ * number of triangular segments that are oriented around a central point and
++ * extend as far out as a given radius. It is built counter-clockwise from a
++ * start angle and a given central angle. It can also be used to create
++ * regular polygons, where the number of segments determines the number of
++ * sides.
++ *
++ * ```js
++ * const geometry = new THREE.CircleGeometry( 5, 32 );
++ * const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial( { color: 0xffff00 } );
++ * const circle = new THREE.Mesh( geometry, material );
++ * scene.add( circle )
++ * ```
++ *
++ * @augments BufferGeometry
++ */
++class CircleGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
++
++	/**
++	 * Constructs a new circle geometry.
++	 *
++	 * @param {number} [radius=1] - Radius of the circle.
++	 * @param {number} [segments=32] - Number of segments (triangles), minimum = `3`.
++	 * @param {number} [thetaStart=0] - Start angle for first segment in radians.
++	 * @param {number} [thetaLength=Math.PI*2] - The central angle, often called theta,
++	 * of the circular sector in radians. The default value results in a complete circle.
++	 */
++	constructor( radius = 1, segments = 32, thetaStart = 0, thetaLength = Math.PI * 2 ) {
++
++		super();
++
++		this.type = 'CircleGeometry';
++
++		/**
++		 * Holds the constructor parameters that have been
++		 * used to generate the geometry. Any modification
++		 * after instantiation does not change the geometry.
++		 *
++		 * @type {Object}
++		 */
++		this.parameters = {
++			radius: radius,
++			segments: segments,
++			thetaStart: thetaStart,
++			thetaLength: thetaLength
++		};
++
++		segments = Math.max( 3, segments );
++
++		// buffers
++
++		const indices = [];
++		const vertices = [];
++		const normals = [];
++		const uvs = [];
++
++		// helper variables
++
++		const vertex = new Vector3();
++		const uv = new Vector2();
++
++		// center point
++
++		vertices.push( 0, 0, 0 );
++		normals.push( 0, 0, 1 );
++		uvs.push( 0.5, 0.5 );
++
++		for ( let s = 0, i = 3; s <= segments; s ++, i += 3 ) {
++
++			const segment = thetaStart + s / segments * thetaLength;
++
++			// vertex
++
++			vertex.x = radius * Math.cos( segment );
++			vertex.y = radius * Math.sin( segment );
++
++			vertices.push( vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z );
++
++			// normal
++
++			normals.push( 0, 0, 1 );
++
++			// uvs
++
++			uv.x = ( vertices[ i ] / radius + 1 ) / 2;
++			uv.y = ( vertices[ i + 1 ] / radius + 1 ) / 2;
++
++			uvs.push( uv.x, uv.y );
++
++		}
++
++		// indices
++
++		for ( let i = 1; i <= segments; i ++ ) {
++
++			indices.push( i, i + 1, 0 );
++
++		}
++
++		// build geometry
++
++		this.setIndex( indices );
++		this.setAttribute( 'position', new Float32BufferAttribute( vertices, 3 ) );
++		this.setAttribute( 'normal', new Float32BufferAttribute( normals, 3 ) );
++		this.setAttribute( 'uv', new Float32BufferAttribute( uvs, 2 ) );
++
++	}
++
++	copy( source ) {
++
++		super.copy( source );
++
++		this.parameters = Object.assign( {}, source.parameters );
++
++		return this;
++
++	}
++
++	/**
++	 * Factory method for creating an instance of this class from the given
++	 * JSON object.
++	 *
++	 * @param {Object} data - A JSON object representing the serialized geometry.
++	 * @return {CircleGeometry} A new instance.
++	 */
++	static fromJSON( data ) {
++
++		return new CircleGeometry( data.radius, data.segments, data.thetaStart, data.thetaLength );
++
++	}
++
++}

++/**
++ * A geometry class for representing a cylinder.
++ *
++ * ```js
++ * const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry( 5, 5, 20, 32 );
++ * const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial( { color: 0xffff00 } );
++ * const cylinder = new THREE.Mesh( geometry, material );
++ * scene.add( cylinder );
++ * ```
++ *
++ * @augments BufferGeometry
++ */
++class CylinderGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
++
++	/**
++	 * Constructs a new cylinder geometry.
++	 *
++	 * @param {number} [radiusTop=1] - Radius of the cylinder at the top.
++	 * @param {number} [radiusBottom=1] - Radius of the cylinder at the bottom.
++	 * @param {number} [height=1] - Height of the cylinder.
++	 * @param {number} [radialSegments=32] - Number of segmented faces around the circumference of the cylinder.
++	 * @param {number} [heightSegments=1] - Number of rows of faces along the height of the cylinder.
++	 * @param {boolean} [openEnded=false] - Whether the base of the cylinder is open or capped.
++	 * @param {number} [thetaStart=0] - Start angle for first segment, in radians.
++	 * @param {number} [thetaLength=Math.PI*2] - The central angle, often called theta, of the circular sector, in radians.
++	 * The default value results in a complete cylinder.
++	 */
++	constructor( radiusTop = 1, radiusBottom = 1, height = 1, radialSegments = 32, heightSegments = 1, openEnded = false, thetaStart = 0, thetaLength = Math.PI * 2 ) {
++
++		super();
++
++		this.type = 'CylinderGeometry';
++
++		/**
++		 * Holds the constructor parameters that have been
++		 * used to generate the geometry. Any modification
++		 * after instantiation does not change the geometry.
++		 *
++		 * @type {Object}
++		 */
++		this.parameters = {
++			radiusTop: radiusTop,
++			radiusBottom: radiusBottom,
++			height: height,
++			radialSegments: radialSegments,
++			heightSegments: heightSegments,
++			openEnded: openEnded,
++			thetaStart: thetaStart,
++			thetaLength: thetaLength
++		};
++
++		const scope = this;
++
++		radialSegments = Math.floor( radialSegments );
++		heightSegments = Math.floor( heightSegments );
++
++		// buffers
++
++		const indices = [];
++		const vertices = [];
++		const normals = [];
++		const uvs = [];
++
++		// helper variables
++
++		let index = 0;
++		const indexArray = [];
++		const halfHeight = height / 2;
++		let groupStart = 0;
++
++		// generate geometry
++
++		generateTorso();
++
++		if ( openEnded === false ) {
++
++			if ( radiusTop > 0 ) generateCap( true );
++			if ( radiusBottom > 0 ) generateCap( false );
++
++		}
++
++		// build geometry
++
++		this.setIndex( indices );
++		this.setAttribute( 'position', new Float32BufferAttribute( vertices, 3 ) );
++		this.setAttribute( 'normal', new Float32BufferAttribute( normals, 3 ) );
++		this.setAttribute( 'uv', new Float32BufferAttribute( uvs, 2 ) );
++
++		function generateTorso() {
++
++			const normal = new Vector3();
++			const vertex = new Vector3();
++
++			let groupCount = 0;
++
++			// this will be used to calculate the normal
++			const slope = ( radiusBottom - radiusTop ) / height;
++
++			// generate vertices, normals and uvs
++
++			for ( let y = 0; y <= heightSegments; y ++ ) {
++
++				const indexRow = [];
++
++				const v = y / heightSegments;
++
++				// calculate the radius of the current row
++
++				const radius = v * ( radiusBottom - radiusTop ) + radiusTop;
++
++				for ( let x = 0; x <= radialSegments; x ++ ) {
++
++					const u = x / radialSegments;
++
++					const theta = u * thetaLength + thetaStart;
++
++					const sinTheta = Math.sin( theta );
++					const cosTheta = Math.cos( theta );
++
++					// vertex
++
++					vertex.x = radius * sinTheta;
++					vertex.y = - v * height + halfHeight;
++					vertex.z = radius * cosTheta;
++					vertices.push( vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z );
++
++					// normal
++
++					normal.set( sinTheta, slope, cosTheta ).normalize();
++					normals.push( normal.x, normal.y, normal.z );
++
++					// uv
++
++					uvs.push( u, 1 - v );
++
++					// save index of vertex in respective row
++
++					indexRow.push( index ++ );
++
++				}
++
++				// now save vertices of the row in our index array
++
++				indexArray.push( indexRow );
++
++			}
++
++			// generate indices
++
++			for ( let x = 0; x < radialSegments; x ++ ) {
++
++				for ( let y = 0; y < heightSegments; y ++ ) {
++
++					// we use the index array to access the correct indices
++
++					const a = indexArray[ y ][ x ];
++					const b = indexArray[ y + 1 ][ x ];
++					const c = indexArray[ y + 1 ][ x + 1 ];
++					const d = indexArray[ y ][ x + 1 ];
++
++					// faces
++
++					if ( radiusTop > 0 || y !== 0 ) {
++
++						indices.push( a, b, d );
++						groupCount += 3;
++
++					}
++
++					if ( radiusBottom > 0 || y !== heightSegments - 1 ) {
++
++						indices.push( b, c, d );
++						groupCount += 3;
++
++					}
++
++				}
++
++			}
++
++			// add a group to the geometry. this will ensure multi material support
++
++			scope.addGroup( groupStart, groupCount, 0 );
++
++			// calculate new start value for groups
++
++			groupStart += groupCount;
++
++		}
++
++		function generateCap( top ) {
++
++			// save the index of the first center vertex
++			const centerIndexStart = index;
++
++			const uv = new Vector2();
++			const vertex = new Vector3();
++
++			let groupCount = 0;
++
++			const radius = ( top === true ) ? radiusTop : radiusBottom;
++			const sign = ( top === true ) ? 1 : -1;
++
++			// first we generate the center vertex data of the cap.
++			// because the geometry needs one set of uvs per face,
++			// we must generate a center vertex per face/segment
++
++			for ( let x = 1; x <= radialSegments; x ++ ) {
++
++				// vertex
++
++				vertices.push( 0, halfHeight * sign, 0 );
++
++				// normal
++
++				normals.push( 0, sign, 0 );
++
++				// uv
++
++				uvs.push( 0.5, 0.5 );
++
++				// increase index
++
++				index ++;
++
++			}
++
++			// save the index of the last center vertex
++			const centerIndexEnd = index;
++
++			// now we generate the surrounding vertices, normals and uvs
++
++			for ( let x = 0; x <= radialSegments; x ++ ) {
++
++				const u = x / radialSegments;
++				const theta = u * thetaLength + thetaStart;
++
++				const cosTheta = Math.cos( theta );
++				const sinTheta = Math.sin( theta );
++
++				// vertex
++
++				vertex.x = radius * sinTheta;
++				vertex.y = halfHeight * sign;
++				vertex.z = radius * cosTheta;
++				vertices.push( vertex.x, vertex.y, vertex.z );
++
++				// normal
++
++				normals.push( 0, sign, 0 );
++
++				// uv
++
++				uv.x = ( cosTheta * 0.5 ) + 0.5;
++				uv.y = ( sinTheta * 0.5 * sign ) + 0.5;
++				uvs.push( uv.x, uv.y );
++
++				// increase index
++
++				index ++;
++
++			}
++
++			// generate indices
++
++			for ( let x = 0; x < radialSegments; x ++ ) {
++
++				const c = centerIndexStart + x;
++				const i = centerIndexEnd + x;
++
++				if ( top === true ) {
++
++					// face top
++
++					indices.push( i, i + 1, c );
++
++				} else {
++
++					// face bottom
++
++					indices.push( i + 1, i, c );
++
++				}
++
++				groupCount += 3;
++
++			}
++
++			// add a group to the geometry. this will ensure multi material support
++
++			scope.addGroup( groupStart, groupCount, top === true ? 1 : 2 );
++
++			// calculate new start value for groups
++
++			groupStart += groupCount;
++
++		}
++
++	}
++
++	copy( source ) {
++
++		super.copy( source );
++
++		this.parameters = Object.assign( {}, source.parameters );
++
++		return this;
++
++	}
++
++	/**
++	 * Factory method for creating an instance of this class from the given
++	 * JSON object.
++	 *
++	 * @param {Object} data - A JSON object representing the serialized geometry.
++	 * @return {CylinderGeometry} A new instance.
++	 */
++	static fromJSON( data ) {
++
++		return new CylinderGeometry( data.radiusTop, data.radiusBottom, data.height, data.radialSegments, data.heightSegments, data.openEnded, data.thetaStart, data.thetaLength );
++
++	}
++
++}

++/**

++		 * @type {Object}
